_about: The Instituta Cnuti in the translator’s order, assembled by tools/incn/reading.py from the clause files (“beside”: printed by Liebermann beside the law it translates; “list”: printed in his list, Gesetze I pp. 612–615).

passages.text: <seg type="parallel"><label>H Di</label><ptr n="2" target="InCn_Inscr.lnote.oe.2"/>Incipiunt <hi rend="spaced">quędam</hi> instituta de legibus regum Anglorum (<hi rend="italic">H</hi>; <hi rend="spaced">instituta secundum Cnud regem</hi> Anglorum <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>).</seg><seg type="parallel"><label>Ip Hunt (Interpolator of Henry of Huntingdon)</label>Incipit <hi rend="spaced">lex que Anglice Danelage</hi><ptr n="c" target="InCn_Inscr.lnote.oe.c"/><hi rend="spaced"> est uocata, Latine uero lex Dacorum est interpretata, ab inuictissimo et glorioso</hi> <hi rend="small">rege Anglorum, Dacorum, Norwagenorum, Sueuorum</hi><ptr n="d" target="InCn_Inscr.lnote.oe.d"/> Cnuto instituta et diligenter custodita.</seg>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">Inscriptio fehlt Rl T; statt des Anfangs setzt den Prolog der</hi> Consiliatio Cnuti (<hi rend="italic">s. o. Anm. a</hi>) <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: Inscriptio missing in Rl T; in place of the beginning Cb puts the prologue of the Consiliatio Cnuti (see above note a)

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">dieser Irrthum, Cnut's Codex für Dänisch und</hi> Dena lagu <hi rend="italic">für seinen Namen zu halten, zeigt, wie fremd um</hi> 1175 <hi rend="italic">die vornormannischen Gesetze und Staatseintheilung erschienen</hi>
notes.en: this error of taking Cnut’s code for Danish and Dena lagu for its name shows how alien the pre-Norman laws and division of the realm seemed around 1175

passages.en: <seg type="parallel"><label>H Di</label>Here begin <hi rend="spaced">certain</hi> institutes concerning the laws of the kings of the English (<hi rend="italic">H</hi>; <hi rend="spaced">institutes according to King Cnut</hi> of the English <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>).</seg><seg type="parallel"><label>Ip Hunt (Interpolator of Henry of Huntingdon)</label>Here begins <hi rend="spaced">the law which in English is called <hi rend="italic">Danelage</hi>, but in Latin is rendered as the law of the Danes,</hi> instituted and diligently kept <hi rend="spaced">by the most invincible and glorious</hi> <hi rend="small">king of the English, Danes, Norwegians, Swedes</hi>, Cnut.</seg>

passages.text: Hęc est institutio, quam Cnud<ptr n="5" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.5-3"/> rex cum<ptr n="6" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.6-4"/> <hi rend="spaced">consilio</hi><ptr n="7" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.7-3"/><hi rend="spaced"> principum</hi> suorum sapientium ad laudem Dei et honorem<ptr n="8" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.8-2"/> sui ipsius et profectum<ptr n="9" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.9"/> <hi rend="bold">totius regni</hi><ptr n="10" target="ICn_Prol.lnote.oe.10"/><hi rend="bold"> cui preerat</hi> instituit.

notes.de: Cnut <hi rend="italic">Rl Lb Jo Va;</hi> Cnutus <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> Chnutus <hi rend="italic">S Pl</hi>
notes.en: Cnut Rl Lb Jo Va; Cnutus Cb; Chnutus S Pl

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb Lb S Ct Jo Va</hi>
notes.en: lacking in Cb Lb S Ct Jo Va

notes.de: ecclesie et dignitatem <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Cb aus Consil.</hi>
notes.en: ecclesie et dignitatem added by Cb from the Consil.

passages.en: This is the institution which King Cnut, with the <hi rend="spaced">counsel of the chief men</hi>, his wise men, instituted to the praise of God and the honour of himself and the benefit <hi rend="bold">of the whole kingdom over which he ruled</hi>.

passages.text: <ptr n="†" target="ICn_1.lnote.oe.dagger"/>Inprimis, quod super omnia uellet semper unum Deum<ptr n="11" target="ICn_1.lnote.oe.11-2"/> colere, amare, honorare, unam fidem Christi unanimiter seruare, ęcclesias Dei in pace et<ptr n="12" target="ICn_1.lnote.oe.12-2"/> securitate custodire <hi rend="spaced">easdemque</hi><ptr n="13" target="ICn_1.lnote.oe.13-2"/> sepius frequentare <hi rend="bold">pro quiete et stabilitate regni sui pro-</hi>
passages.en: First, that above all things he would always worship one God, love, honour [him], keep with one mind the one faith of Christ, guard the churches of God in peace and security, <hi rend="spaced">and the same</hi> frequent more often, <hi rend="bold">for the quiet and stability of his kingdom and for …</hi>

passages.text: que <hi rend="spaced">salute corporis et animę suę</hi>.
passages.en: … <hi rend="spaced">the salvation of his body and soul</hi>.

passages.text: Omnis <hi rend="spaced">itaque</hi> ęcclesia secundum normam iusticię <hi rend="spaced">debet</hi> esse in propria<ptr n="1" target="ICn_2-1.lnote.oe.1"/> pace et securitate Dei; et omni Christiano conuenit maximam reuerentiam <hi rend="spaced">exhibere ęcclesiis Dei</hi>; pax enim et securitas Dei summa diligentia promerenda et<ptr n="2" target="ICn_2-1.lnote.oe.2-4"/> tenenda est, deinde pax et securitas regis.
passages.en: Every church <hi rend="spaced">therefore</hi> according to the rule of justice <hi rend="spaced">ought</hi> to be in God's own peace and security; and it befits every Christian <hi rend="spaced">to show the churches of God</hi> the greatest reverence; for the peace and security of God is to be earned and held with the utmost diligence, and next the peace and security of the king.

passages.text: Quare ęquissimum est, ut pax ęcclesiarum Dei infra parietes et pax <hi rend="spaced">data manu</hi> Christiani<ptr n="1" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.1-2"/> regis semper stet inuiolata; et qui aliquam<ptr n="3" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.3"/>, ęcclesię<ptr n="4" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.4-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">scilicet aut regis pacem</hi>, fregerit, careat <hi rend="spaced">omnibus bonis suis</hi> et<ptr n="5" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.5"/> uita<ptr n="6" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.6-2"/>, nisi rex illi<ptr n="7" target="ICn_2-2.lnote.oe.7-2"/> parcere uoluerit.

notes.de: condonauerit <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> i. p. u. <hi rend="italic">Lb S Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: condonauerit instead of i. p. u. Lb S Ct Jo

passages.en: Wherefore it is most just that the peace of the churches of God within the walls and the peace <hi rend="spaced">given by the hand</hi> of a Christian king always stand inviolate; and whoever breaks either, <hi rend="spaced">namely the peace of the church or of the king</hi>, let him lose <hi rend="spaced">all his goods</hi> and life, unless the king will spare him.

passages.text: Quodsi dehinc<ptr n="8" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.8-2"/> aliquis<ptr n="9" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.9-2"/> pacem ęcclesiarum Dei ita uiolauerit, ut infra parietes <hi rend="spaced">homicidium faciat</hi>, hoc sit inemendabile, persequaturque<ptr n="10" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.10-2"/> talem<ptr n="11" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.11"/> omnis qui <hi rend="spaced">uoluerit</hi> Dei<ptr n="12" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.12"/> esse amicus, nisi hoc fiat, ut effugiat et talem locum <hi rend="bold">aut hominem</hi> requirat, pro qua<ptr n="13" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.13"/> <hi rend="spaced">requisitione</hi><ptr n="14" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.14"/> ei<ptr n="15" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.15"/> rex uitam<ptr n="16" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.16-2"/> condonet<ptr n="17" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.17-2"/>, <hi rend="spaced">attamen</hi> ad plenam emendationem.<ptr n="18" target="ICn_2-3.lnote.oe.18-2"/>

notes.de: deinde <hi rend="italic">Lb S Ct Jo; fehlt Cb</hi>
notes.en: deinde Lb S Ct Jo; lacking in Cb

notes.de: e. D. <hi rend="italic">Di;</hi> e. a. D. <hi rend="italic">Cb Ct</hi>
notes.en: e. D. Di; e. a. D. Cb Ct

notes.de: quo uel cuius <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> qua <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: quo uel cuius instead of qua Cb

notes.de: rex ei <hi rend="italic">Cb; fehlt Lb Ct</hi>
notes.en: rex ei Cb; lacking in Lb Ct

passages.en: But if henceforth anyone so violates the peace of the churches of God that he <hi rend="spaced">commits homicide</hi> within the walls, this shall be unatonable, and let everyone who <hi rend="spaced">wishes</hi> to be a friend of God pursue such a man, unless it happens that he escapes and seeks such a place <hi rend="bold">or man</hi> that for this <hi rend="spaced">seeking</hi> the king grants him his life, <hi rend="spaced">yet</hi> on condition of full amends.

passages.text: Si autem<ptr n="1" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.1-4"/> ad<ptr n="2" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.2-4"/> emendationem peruenerit<ptr n="3" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.3-3"/>, et rex hoc permiserit, ante omnia<ptr n="4" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.4-3"/> ęcclesię pacem fractam pleniter<ptr n="5" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.5-3"/> emendet secundum<ptr n="6" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.6"/> plenam forisfacturam, <hi rend="spaced">quam Angli nominant</hi><ptr n="7" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.7"/> múndbrece<ptr n="8" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.8"/>, <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="9" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.9"/>)</seg> ęcclesię reconciliationem adquirat, <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="9" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.9"/>)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">plenam emendationem</hi> parentibus et domino occisi<ptr n="10" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.10"/> persoluat, quam<ptr n="11" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.11"/> Angli mæibote<ptr n="12" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.12"/> et<ptr n="13" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.13"/> manbote<ptr n="14" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.14"/> <hi rend="spaced">dicunt</hi><ptr n="15" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.15"/>, et super omnia Deo satisfaciat<ptr n="16" target="ICn_2-5.lnote.oe.16"/> <hi rend="bold">secundum decretum episcopi</hi>.

notes.de: meib. <hi rend="italic">T;</hi> metib. <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> mundb. <hi rend="italic">Lb Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: meib. T; metib. Cb; mundb. Lb Ct Jo

passages.en: But if he comes to amends, and the king permits it, before all things let him fully make amends for the broken peace of the church according to the full forfeiture, <hi rend="spaced">which the English name</hi> <hi rend="italic">múndbrece</hi> [breach of protection], <seg type="recension">(and)</seg> obtain reconciliation for the church, <seg type="recension">(and)</seg> pay <hi rend="spaced">full amends</hi> to the kinsmen and the lord of the slain man, which the English <hi rend="spaced">call</hi> <hi rend="italic">mæibote</hi> and <hi rend="italic">manbote</hi> [compensation to kin and to lord], and above all make satisfaction to God <hi rend="bold">according to the bishop's decree</hi>.

passages.text: Sin <hi rend="spaced">autem</hi><ptr n="17" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.17"/> aliter<ptr n="18" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.18"/> de uiuis pax<ptr n="19" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.19"/> ęcclesię uiolata fuerit uel pugnando<ptr n="20" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.20"/> uel <hi rend="spaced">rapiendo</hi> uel per<ptr n="21" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.21"/> quicquid sit<ptr n="22" target="ICn_3.lnote.oe.22"/>,

notes.de: u. f. p. e. <hi rend="italic">Lb Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: u. f. p. e. Lb Ct Jo
quomodocunque instead of p. q. Cb

passages.en: If <hi rend="spaced">however</hi> the peace of the church is otherwise violated by the living, either by fighting or by <hi rend="spaced">robbing</hi> or by whatever it may be,

passages.text: imprimis semper<ptr n="23" target="ICn_3a.lnote.oe.23"/> fiat emendatio ęcclesię secundum qualitatem <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="24" target="ICn_3a.lnote.oe.24"/> dignitatem)</seg> eius.
passages.en: first of all let amends always be made to the church according to its quality <seg type="recension">(and dignity)</seg>.

passages.text: Non <hi rend="spaced">enim</hi><ptr n="25" target="ICn_3-1.lnote.oe.25"/> sunt omnes ęcclesię<ptr n="26" target="ICn_3-1.lnote.oe.26"/> <hi rend="spaced">unius eiusdemque</hi><ptr n="27" target="ICn_3-1.lnote.oe.27"/> honoris, quamuis habeant<ptr n="28" target="ICn_3-1.lnote.oe.28"/> <hi rend="spaced">unam eandemque</hi><ptr n="29" target="ICn_3-1.lnote.oe.29"/> consecrationem.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S Pl Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: lacking in Lb S Pl Ct Jo

notes.de: et eiusdem <hi rend="italic">Pl Jo;</hi> et eius <hi rend="italic">Ct</hi>
notes.en: et eiusdem Pl Jo; et eius Ct

passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">For</hi> not all churches are of <hi rend="spaced">one and the same</hi> honour, although they have <hi rend="spaced">one and the same</hi> consecration.

passages.text: Principales <hi rend="spaced">autem</hi><ptr n="30" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.30"/> ęcclesię, <hi rend="bold">sicut</hi><ptr n="31" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.31"/><hi rend="bold"> episcopatus </hi><seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(et</hi><ptr n="32" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.32"/><hi rend="bold"> abbatię)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold">,</hi> talem<ptr n="33" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.33"/> <hi rend="spaced">emendationem</hi> uiolatę pacis secundum legem Anglorum <hi rend="spaced">habere</hi><ptr n="34" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.34"/><hi rend="spaced"> debent</hi>: mundam regis, hoc est quinque libras; <hi rend="bold">secundum</hi><ptr n="35" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.35"/><hi rend="bold"> certe</hi><ptr n="36" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.36"/><hi rend="bold"> legem Danorum octo</hi><ptr n="37" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.37"/><hi rend="bold"> libras.</hi><seg type="parallel"><label>Cb</label>Mediocres autem ecclesie, <hi rend="bold">ut abatie et canonicatus,</hi> iuxta forisfacturam regis, uidelicet <hi rend="bold">XXC</hi> solidos, <hi rend="bold">hoc est qaatuor libras.</hi> Minores quidem ecclesie, hoc est ubi<ptr n="38" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.38"/> seruitium fit, et tamen cimiterium habent, LX<ptr n="39" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.39"/> solidos <hi rend="bold">hoc est tres libras.</hi> <hi rend="spaced">Minime uero ecclesie</hi>, quam <hi rend="spaced">Angli</hi> feldcherche dicunt, id est carentes cimiterio, XXX sol.</seg><seg type="parallel"><label>H Di Lb S Ct Jo</label>Mediocris autem<ptr n="40" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.40"/> ęcclesię <hi rend="bold">duas libras,</hi> hoc est secundum forisfacturam regis, et adhuc minoris ęcclesię, hoc<ptr n="41" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.41"/> est ubi parum seruitii<ptr n="42" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.42"/> fit, et tamen cimiterium habet, forisfactura est <hi rend="bold">unius</hi><ptr n="43" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.43"/><hi rend="bold"> libre;</hi> minimę uero<ptr n="44" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.44"/> ęcclesię, quam<ptr n="45" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.45"/> Angli feldcirice<ptr n="46" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.46"/> uocant, <hi rend="bold">octoginta denariorum.</hi><ptr n="47" target="ICn_3-2.lnote.oe.47"/></seg>

notes.de: et a. <hi rend="italic">fehlt hier Cb; vgl. sieben Zeilen weiter</hi>
notes.en: et a. lacking here in Cb; cf. seven lines further on
s. — o. libras lacking in Ct
autem S; lacking in Lb Jo

notes.de: h. e. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: h. e. lacking in Lb S Ct Jo

notes.de: XX sol. <hi rend="italic">Lb S Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: XX sol. Lb S Ct Jo

passages.en: The chief churches <hi rend="spaced">however</hi>, <hi rend="bold">such as bishoprics </hi><seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(and abbeys)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold">,</hi> <hi rend="spaced">ought to have</hi> such <hi rend="spaced">amends</hi> for violated peace according to the law of the English: the king's <hi rend="italic">mund</hi> [protection], that is five pounds; <hi rend="bold">but according to the law of the Danes, certainly, eight pounds.</hi><seg type="parallel"><label>Cb</label>But middling churches, <hi rend="bold">such as abbeys and houses of canons,</hi> according to the king's forfeiture, namely <hi rend="bold">XXC</hi> shillings, <hi rend="bold">that is four pounds.</hi> The lesser churches, that is where service is held and yet they have a cemetery, 60 shillings, <hi rend="bold">that is three pounds.</hi> <hi rend="spaced">But the least churches</hi>, which <hi rend="spaced">the English</hi> call <hi rend="italic">feldcherche</hi> [field-church], that is those lacking a cemetery, 30 shillings.</seg><seg type="parallel"><label>H Di Lb S Ct Jo</label>But for a middling church <hi rend="bold">two pounds,</hi> that is according to the king's forfeiture, and further for a lesser church, that is where little service is held and yet it has a cemetery, the forfeiture is <hi rend="bold">one pound;</hi> but for the least church, which the English call <hi rend="italic">feldcirice</hi> [field-church], <hi rend="bold">eighty pence.</hi></seg>

passages.text: Omnibus <hi rend="spaced">igitur</hi><ptr n="1" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.1-4"/> Christianis iustissime decet <seg type="recension">(cum<ptr n="2" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.2-3"/>)</seg> summa diligentia semper<ptr n="3" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.3-2"/> uenerari<ptr n="4" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.4"/> <hi rend="spaced">reliquias sanctorum</hi>, ordinatos<ptr n="5" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.5"/> et domos sanctificatas et unumquemque ordinem secundum mensuram<ptr n="6" target="ICn_4.lnote.oe.6"/> <hi rend="bold">et uitam suam</hi> honorare.

notes.de: r. sa., ordinatos et d. sa. se. uen. <hi rend="italic">H Di Lb Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: r. sa., ordinatos et d. sa. se. uen. H Di Lb Ct Jo

passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">Therefore</hi> it most justly befits all Christians always to venerate <seg type="recension">(with)</seg> the utmost diligence <hi rend="spaced">the relics of the saints</hi>, and to honour the ordained and hallowed houses and each order according to its measure <hi rend="bold">and its life</hi>.

passages.text: Propterea qui<ptr n="7" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.7"/> <hi rend="bold">uult</hi> cognoscat<ptr n="8" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.8"/>, multum<ptr n="9" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.9"/> est et magnum quod sacerdos habet<ptr n="10" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.10"/> ad<ptr n="11" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.11"/> faciendum populo ad<ptr n="12" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.12"/> necessitatem <seg type="recension">(profectum<ptr n="13" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.13"/>)</seg>, si<ptr n="14" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.14"/> ipse Domino recte placuerit <seg type="recension">(qui Domino<ptr n="15" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.15"/> <hi rend="spaced">suo desiderat et studet</hi> iuste<ptr n="16" target="ICn_4-1.lnote.oe.16"/> placere)</seg>.

notes.de: intelligat quisquis bene scit, magnum est et bonum quod <hi rend="italic">auf Rasur H</hi>
notes.en: intelligat quisquis bene scit, magnum est et bonum quod on an erasure H

notes.de: cognoscere <hi rend="italic">T; fehlt Lb S Ct;</hi> prouideat <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>
notes.en: cognoscere T; omitted in Lb S Ct; prouideat Di

notes.de: ad f. po. ad pr. h. <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>
notes.en: ad f. po. ad pr. h. Di

notes.de: facere ad po. nec. <hi rend="italic">auf Rasur H</hi>
notes.en: facere ad po. nec. on an erasure H

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so</hi> [<hi rend="italic">Glosse</hi>] <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> nec. <hi rend="italic">Di T S Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: thus [a gloss] instead of nec. Di T S Ct Jo

notes.de: si — placuerit <hi rend="italic">nur H auf Rasur;</hi> qui — placere <hi rend="italic">übrige</hi>
notes.en: si — placuerit only H, on an erasure; qui — placere the others

notes.de: s. D. <hi rend="italic">Di Lb S Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: s. D. Di Lb S Ct Jo

passages.en: Therefore let him who <hi rend="bold">wishes</hi> know that much and great is what the priest has to do for the people for their need <seg type="recension">(benefit)</seg>, if he himself rightly pleases the Lord <seg type="recension">(who <hi rend="spaced">desires and strives</hi> to please <hi rend="spaced">his</hi> Lord justly)</seg>.

passages.text: Magna enim<ptr n="17" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.17"/> est<ptr n="18" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.18"/> adiuratio et maior consecratio, quę<ptr n="19" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.19"/> demonia eiciunt et in fugam uertunt, quotiens <hi rend="spaced">infans baptizatur</hi> aut corpus<ptr n="20" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.20"/> Domini consecratur; <hi rend="spaced">certe</hi> angeli circumuolant<ptr n="21" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.21"/> et per Dei uirtutem sacerdoti auxilium prębent, facta muniunt, quotiens Christo digne seruiunt.<ptr n="22" target="ICn_4-2.lnote.oe.22"/>

notes.de: qua <hi rend="italic">Lb S Pl Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: qua Lb S Pl Ct Jo

notes.de: -uit <hi rend="italic">T; hier schieben I Cnut</hi> 5<hi rend="italic">aa ein Cb T</hi>
notes.en: -uit T; here Cb T insert I Cnut 5aa

passages.en: For great is the adjuration and greater the consecration, which cast out demons and put them to flight, whenever <hi rend="spaced">an infant is baptized</hi> or the Lord's body is consecrated; <hi rend="spaced">certainly</hi> angels fly around and by God's power give help to the priest and protect his deeds, whenever they serve Christ worthily.

passages.text: Sic<ptr n="23" target="ICn_4-3.lnote.oe.23"/> etiam semper faciunt, cum deuote Christum inuocant pro populi necessitate et <hi rend="spaced">Deo</hi> preces fundunt; et<ptr n="24" target="ICn_4-3.lnote.oe.24"/> ideo in tali ordine <seg type="recension">(ut<ptr n="25" target="ICn_4-3.lnote.oe.25"/> <hi rend="spaced">diximus</hi>)</seg> magna debet esse discretio et <hi rend="spaced">consideratio</hi>.

notes.en: quia instead of et i. Cb

passages.en: So too they always do, when they devoutly invoke Christ for the people's need and pour out prayers to <hi rend="spaced">God</hi>; and therefore in such an order <seg type="recension">(as <hi rend="spaced">we have said</hi>)</seg> there ought to be great discretion and <hi rend="spaced">consideration</hi>.

passages.text: Si contigerit presbyterum<ptr n="26" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.26"/> regulariter et <hi rend="spaced">caste</hi> uiuentem calumniari de latrocinio aut<ptr n="27" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.27"/> de incantatione uel de aliqua huiusmodi<ptr n="28" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.28"/> <seg type="recension">(simili)</seg> re<ptr n="20" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.20-2"/>, et negauerit, ita se purgabit<ptr n="29" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.29"/>, si audet: missam celebret et per<ptr n="30" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.30"/> corpus Domini solus de una appellatione, <hi rend="spaced">quam Angli uocant</hi> anfealde spæce<ptr n="31" target="ICn_5.lnote.oe.31"/>, se purget.

notes.de: de latr. cal. pr. re. et c. ui. <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>
notes.en: de latr. cal. pr. re. et c. ui. Di
thus Cb T; sim. the others

notes.de: speche <hi rend="italic">Cb T Lb;</hi> spreche <hi rend="italic">Jo</hi>
notes.en: speche Cb T Lb; spreche Jo

passages.en: If it happens that a priest living by rule and <hi rend="spaced">chastely</hi> is accused of theft or of sorcery or of any such <seg type="recension">(similar)</seg> matter, and he denies it, he shall clear himself thus, if he dares: let him celebrate mass and clear himself alone by the body of the Lord of a single accusation, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">anfealde spæce</hi> [single charge].

passages.text: Si <hi rend="spaced">autem</hi> diaconus qui regulariter uiuit calumniatur simpla appellatione, acceptis duobus diaconibus secum, purget se.
passages.en: If <hi rend="spaced">however</hi> a deacon who lives by rule is accused by a single accusation, let him clear himself, taking two deacons with him.

passages.text: Et si tres calumnię fuerint, assumat<ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-1a.lnote.oe.1-2"/> VI <hi rend="spaced">secum</hi> et ipse sit septimus <seg type="recension">(sex secum <hi rend="spaced">diaconibus</hi> acceptis, ita se purget)</seg>.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

passages.en: And if there are three accusations, let him take six <hi rend="spaced">with him</hi> and himself be the seventh <seg type="recension">(having taken six <hi rend="spaced">deacons</hi> with him, let him so clear himself)</seg>.

passages.text: Si uulgaris<ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-2.lnote.oe.1"/> <seg type="recension">(popularis)</seg> presbyter calumniatur<ptr n="2" target="ICn_5-2.lnote.oe.2"/>, qui non regulariter uiuit, <hi rend="spaced">simpla</hi><ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-2.lnote.oe.1"/> appellatione <seg type="recension">(de supradictis)</seg>, purget se sicut diaconus<ptr n="*" target="ICn_5-2.lnote.oe.star"/> qui regulariter uiuit.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

notes.de: qui n. r. u., c. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: qui n. r. u., c. Cb

notes.de: di. re. uiuens, scilicet assumens duos, et ipse sit tertius; et si de triplici appellatione, sumat sex et ipse sit septimus [<hi rend="italic">aus</hi> 5, 1; 5, 1<hi rend="italic">a</hi>] <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Cb.</hi>
notes.en: di. re. uiuens, scilicet assumens duos, et ipse sit tertius; et si de triplici appellatione, sumat sex et ipse sit septimus [from 5, 1; 5, 1a] added by Cb.

passages.en: If a common <seg type="recension">(popular)</seg> priest, who does not live by rule, is accused by a <hi rend="spaced">single</hi> accusation <seg type="recension">(of the above-said)</seg>, let him clear himself like a deacon who lives by rule.

passages.text: Si <hi rend="bold">aduena aut</hi><ptr n="3" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.3-2"/> <hi rend="bold">peregrinus</hi> ordinatus calumniatur de <hi rend="spaced">iam nominatis</hi> criminibus, qui<ptr n="4" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.4-2"/> adiutorium<ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.1"/> <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">aliud auxilium</hi>)</seg> non habet, eat ad panem benedictum, quem <hi rend="spaced">Angli</hi><ptr n="5" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.5-2"/> corsnade <hi rend="spaced">uocant</hi>, et ibi inueniet<ptr n="6" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.6-3"/> quod<ptr n="7" target="ICn_5-2a.lnote.oe.7-3"/> Deo placuerit.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">verb. aus</hi> et <hi rend="italic">H;</hi> uel <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: corrected from et H; uel Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S;</hi> u. c. <hi rend="italic">T</hi>
notes.en: omitted in Lb S; u. c. T

passages.en: If an ordained <hi rend="bold">stranger or</hi> <hi rend="bold">foreigner</hi> is accused of the <hi rend="spaced">already named</hi> crimes, who has no helper <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">other aid</hi>)</seg>, let him go to the blessed bread, which <hi rend="spaced">the English</hi> <hi rend="spaced">call</hi> <hi rend="italic">corsnade</hi> [<hi rend="italic">corsnæd</hi>, ordeal morsel], and there he will find what pleases God.

passages.text: Si quis ordinatus calumniatur de homicidio, quod fuisset<ptr n="8" target="ICn_5-2b.lnote.oe.8-2"/> in facto<ptr n="9" target="ICn_5-2b.lnote.oe.9-3"/> aut in consilio, purget se cum parentibus suis, qui<ptr n="10" target="ICn_5-2b.lnote.oe.10"/> possunt emendare<ptr n="11" target="ICn_5-2b.lnote.oe.11"/> aut deportare.

notes.de: qui — sociis <hi rend="italic">in</hi> 5, 2<hi rend="italic">c überspringt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: qui — sociis in 5, 2c skipped by Lb S

passages.en: If any ordained man is accused of homicide, that he had been in it by deed or by counsel, let him clear himself with his kinsmen, who can pay the amends or bear [the feud].

passages.text: Si non habet parentes, purget se cum sociis uel<ptr n="12" target="ICn_5-2c.lnote.oe.12-2"/> incipiat<ptr n="13" target="ICn_5-2c.lnote.oe.13"/> ieiunare et sic eat ad panem benedictum, <hi rend="spaced">de quo supra diximus</hi>, et ibi inueniet<ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-2c.lnote.oe.1"/> quod Deo placitum fuerit <seg type="recension">(inueniat Deo placita)</seg>.

notes.de: suis; quos si non habuerit <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> uel <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: suis; quos si non habuerit instead of uel Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

passages.en: If he has no kinsmen, let him clear himself with companions or begin to fast and so go to the blessed bread, <hi rend="spaced">of which we spoke above</hi>, and there he will find what has pleased God <seg type="recension">(let him find what pleases God)</seg>.

passages.text: Nullus monachus monasterialis debet emendare homicidium nec petere<ptr n="14" target="ICn_5-2d.lnote.oe.14-2"/> emendationem homicidii, <hi rend="bold">licet sit parens occisoris</hi><ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-2d.lnote.oe.1"/> <seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(occidentium)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold"> uel occisi</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">quia</hi> ubi intrat<ptr n="15" target="ICn_5-2d.lnote.oe.15-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">monasterium</hi> pro tenenda regula, relinquit<ptr n="16" target="ICn_5-2d.lnote.oe.16"/> <hi rend="spaced">ea quę sunt secularia</hi> . . . .<ptr n="17" target="ICn_5-2d.lnote.oe.17"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others
there follows Af. 20, see above p. 61

passages.en: No monk of a monastery ought to pay amends for homicide nor seek amends for homicide, <hi rend="bold">though he be a kinsman of the slayer</hi> <seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(of the slayers)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold"> or of the slain</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">because</hi> when he enters the <hi rend="spaced">monastery</hi> to keep the rule, he leaves behind <hi rend="spaced">the things that are secular</hi> . . . .

passages.text: Si quis commendauerit alterius<ptr n="4" target="Af_20.lnote.incn.4"/> monacho pecuniam <hi rend="bold">aut aliquid tale</hi><ptr n="5" target="Af_20.lnote.incn.5"/> <hi rend="spaced">ad custodiendum</hi> sine licentia <hi rend="bold">prelati</hi> sui, et <hi rend="spaced">monachus illud perdiderit, sit illi perditum qui</hi> sine licentia <hi rend="bold">prelati</hi> <hi rend="spaced">eius</hi><ptr n="6" target="Af_20.lnote.incn.6"/> <hi rend="spaced">monacho commendauit</hi> . . . .

notes.en: sui Lb S; lacking in Cb

passages.en: If anyone commends money <hi rend="bold">or any such thing</hi> to another man's monk <hi rend="spaced">for safekeeping</hi> without the leave of his <hi rend="bold">prelate</hi>, and <hi rend="spaced">the monk loses it, let it be lost to him who</hi> without the leave of <hi rend="spaced">his</hi> <hi rend="bold">prelate</hi> <hi rend="spaced">commended it to the monk</hi> . . . .

passages.text: Et si tres <hi rend="spaced">appellationes</hi> fuerint, secum acceptis duobus<ptr n="32" target="ICn_5a.lnote.oe.32"/> presbyteris, purget se, <hi rend="spaced">sicut</hi> prędiximus<ptr n="33" target="ICn_5a.lnote.oe.33"/>, si audet . . . .<ptr n="*" target="ICn_5a.lnote.oe.star"/>

notes.de: [5<hi rend="italic">aa</hi>] Ipse tamen presbiter [si calumpniatur <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>] teneatur usque ad iudicium episcopi [u. ad i. e. t. <hi rend="italic">Cb; dieser Anfang fehlt hier, steht hinter</hi> 4,2 <hi rend="italic">Cb T</hi>]; uel [et <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>] ista tamen fiant secundum iudicium episcopi <hi rend="italic">fügt Inst. zu; vgl. II</hi> 42.
notes.en: [5aa] Ipse tamen presbiter [si calumpniatur Cb] teneatur usque ad iudicium episcopi [u. ad i. e. t. Cb; this beginning is omitted here, and stands after 4,2 in Cb T]; uel [et Cb] ista tamen fiant secundum iudicium episcopi added by Inst.; cf. II 42.

passages.en: And if there are three <hi rend="spaced">accusations</hi>, let him clear himself, taking two priests with him, <hi rend="spaced">as</hi> we said before, if he dares . . . .

passages.text: Presbyter si <hi rend="bold">calumniatus et conuictus fuerit,</hi> quod stetisset in falso testimonio aut iurasset<ptr n="1" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.1-3"/> cum periuris<ptr n="2" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.2-3"/> aut fuisset socius<ptr n="3" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.3-4"/> aut conscius latrocinii<ptr n="4" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.4-3"/>, deponatur á communione et á societate ordinatorum et careat liberalitate<ptr n="5" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.5-2"/> eorum, <hi rend="bold">quod</hi><ptr n="6" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.6"/><hi rend="bold"> Angli uocant þegenscipe</hi><ptr n="7" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.7"/>, nisi profundius satisfaciat Deo et hominibus secundum pręceptum episcopi<ptr n="8" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.8"/> sui, et fideiussores inueniat, quod ab eo tempore amplius cessabit ab eiusmodi<ptr n="9" target="ICn_5-3.lnote.oe.9"/> <hi rend="spaced">operibus</hi>.

notes.de: iurasse c. p. a. fuisse <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>; intrasset <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: iurasse c. p. a. fuisse H Di; intrasset Lb S

notes.de: sopitus aut sciens latrocinium <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: sopitus aut sciens latrocinium Lb S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">verb. aus</hi> latronii <hi rend="italic">H</hi> [<hi rend="italic">ursprünglich vielleicht</hi> latronū]
notes.en: corrected from latronii H [originally perhaps latronū]

passages.en: A priest, if he <hi rend="bold">has been accused and convicted</hi> that he stood in false witness or swore with perjurers or was an accomplice or privy to theft, let him be put out of the communion and fellowship of the ordained and lose their noble rank, <hi rend="bold">which the English call <hi rend="italic">þegenscipe</hi></hi> [thegnship], unless he makes deeper satisfaction to God and men according to his bishop's command, and finds sureties that from that time on he will cease from such <hi rend="spaced">works</hi>.

passages.text: Quodsi <hi rend="spaced">negauerit</hi> et purgare<ptr n="10" target="ICn_5-4.lnote.oe.10"/> sé uoluerit, secundum culpę modum et quantitatem sé purget.
passages.en: But if he <hi rend="spaced">denies</hi> it and wishes to clear himself, let him clear himself according to the manner and quantity of the guilt.

passages.text: Hoc etiam statuimus, ut <hi rend="spaced">unusquisque</hi><ptr n="11" target="ICn_6.lnote.oe.11-2"/>, cuiuscumque<ptr n="12" target="ICn_6.lnote.oe.12"/> ordinis <hi rend="spaced">aut</hi><ptr n="13" target="ICn_6.lnote.oe.13"/><hi rend="spaced"> sexus sit</hi><ptr n="14" target="ICn_6.lnote.oe.14"/>, seruet ordinem suum.<ptr n="15" target="ICn_6.lnote.oe.15"/>

notes.de: uel <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>; sit aut <hi rend="spaced">cuiuslibet</hi> sexus, ser. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: uel Lb; sit aut <hi rend="italic">cuiuslibet</hi> sexus, ser. Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="spaced">aut degradetur</hi> <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Lb S</hi>
notes.en: <hi rend="italic">aut degradetur</hi> added by Lb S

passages.en: This also we decree, that <hi rend="spaced">everyone</hi>, of whatever order <hi rend="spaced">or sex he be</hi>, keep his order.

passages.text: Et pręcipue hoc pręcipimus seruis et ancillis Dei, uidelicet episcopis, abbatibus, <hi rend="spaced">abbatissis</hi>, monachis, sanctimonialibus, canonicis, <hi rend="spaced">presbyteris</hi>, nonnis, ut regulariter uiuant <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">sicut</hi><ptr n="16" target="ICn_6a.lnote.oe.16"/><hi rend="spaced"> diximus</hi>)</seg> secundum ordinem uniuscuiusque,
passages.en: And especially we command this to the servants and handmaids of God, namely bishops, abbots, <hi rend="spaced">abbesses</hi>, monks, holy women, canons, <hi rend="spaced">priests</hi>, nuns, that they live by rule <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">as we have said</hi>)</seg> according to the order of each,

passages.text: castitatem seruent, ab ira<ptr n="17" target="ICn_6-1.lnote.oe.17-2"/> Dei sibi caueant <hi rend="bold">et alios uiuendo et monendo castigent,</hi> ut se ab infernali incendio custodiant.
passages.en: keep chastity, beware of the wrath of God <hi rend="bold">and chasten others by living and admonishing,</hi> so that they guard themselves from the fire of hell.

passages.text: Optime enim norunt<ptr n="18" target="ICn_6-2.lnote.oe.18-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">episcopi</hi> et cęteri ordines, quos <hi rend="spaced">supra memoraui</hi><ptr n="19" target="ICn_6-2.lnote.oe.19-2"/> <seg type="recension">(nominaui)</seg>, quod illis nullo modo licet communionem<ptr n="20" target="ICn_6-2.lnote.oe.20"/> mulierum habere nec cum illis coire.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

passages.en: For the <hi rend="spaced">bishops</hi> and the other orders whom I <hi rend="spaced">have mentioned above</hi> <seg type="recension">(named)</seg> know very well that it is in no way lawful for them to have intercourse with women nor to lie with them.

passages.text: Qui autem abhinc a tali <hi rend="spaced">opere</hi> cessare et castitatem custodire uoluerit<ptr n="1" target="ICn_6-2a.lnote.oe.1-4"/> <seg type="recension">(studuerit)</seg>, misericordiam Dei habeat et secundum dignitatem<ptr n="2" target="ICn_6-2a.lnote.oe.2-3"/> seculi liberalitatem<ptr n="3" target="ICn_6-2a.lnote.oe.3-2"/>, <hi rend="spaced">quam</hi> <hi rend="spaced">Angli uocant</hi><ptr n="4" target="ICn_6-2a.lnote.oe.4-2"/> þegenscipe.<ptr n="5" target="ICn_6-2a.lnote.oe.5-2"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">vor der Klammer Cb; eingeklammertes übrige</hi>
notes.en: the text before the bracket Cb; the bracketed text the others

notes.de: theg. <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>; thengesshipe habeat <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: theg. H Di; thengesshipe habeat Lb S

passages.en: But he who henceforth wishes <seg type="recension">(strives)</seg> to cease from such <hi rend="spaced">work</hi> and to keep chastity, let him have the mercy of God and, according to worldly dignity, the noble rank <hi rend="spaced">which</hi> <hi rend="spaced">the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">þegenscipe</hi> [thegnship].

passages.text: Omnem etiam Christianum obnixe <hi rend="spaced">precamur</hi>, fornicationem deuitare, leges et <hi rend="spaced">praecepta</hi> Dei diligenter custodire.
passages.en: We also earnestly <hi rend="spaced">pray</hi> every Christian to avoid fornication and to keep diligently the laws and <hi rend="spaced">precepts</hi> of God.

passages.text: Hoc quoque rogamus et in nomine <hi rend="spaced">Domini</hi><ptr n="6" target="ICn_7.lnote.oe.6"/> pręcipimus, ut nullus Christianus accipiat sibi<ptr n="7" target="ICn_7.lnote.oe.7-2"/> uxorem infra sextum <hi rend="bold">genu</hi>, nec in relicta uxore, quę ita <hi rend="spaced">fuit</hi> propinquo parenti <hi rend="spaced">coniuncta</hi>, nec in parente<ptr n="8" target="ICn_7.lnote.oe.8-3"/> uxoris suę, quam ante habuit;
passages.en: This also we ask and command in the name of the <hi rend="spaced">Lord</hi>, that no Christian take to himself a wife within the sixth <hi rend="bold">knee</hi> [degree], nor the widow who <hi rend="spaced">was</hi> thus <hi rend="spaced">joined</hi> to a near kinsman, nor a kinswoman of the wife whom he had before;

passages.text: nec in compatra<ptr n="9" target="ICn_7-1.lnote.oe.9-2"/> sua nec in consecrata <hi rend="bold">sanctimoniali</hi> aut nonna nec in alterius relicta, <hi rend="spaced">quam Angli uocant</hi> oþres<ptr n="10" target="ICn_7-1.lnote.oe.10"/> <hi rend="bold">mannes</hi> ælǽte<ptr n="11" target="ICn_7-1.lnote.oe.11"/>: talibus, <hi rend="spaced">ut diximus</hi>, nemo Christianus se iungat;

notes.de: ælete <hi rend="italic">T</hi>; eðlete <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; lete <hi rend="italic">Lb Jo</hi>
notes.en: ælete T; eðlete Cb; lete Lb Jo

passages.en: nor his fellow godparent, nor a consecrated <hi rend="bold">holy woman</hi> or nun, nor another man's widow, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">oþres <hi rend="bold">mannes</hi> ælǽte</hi> [another man's relict]: to such, <hi rend="spaced">as we said</hi>, let no Christian join himself;

passages.text: nec habeat nisi unam<ptr n="12" target="ICn_7-3.lnote.oe.12"/> uxorem, quę sit ei legitime desponsata, eaque sola, dum uiuit, <hi rend="bold">sana et infirma,</hi> sit contentus.
passages.en: nor let him have more than one wife, who is lawfully betrothed to him, and with her alone, while she lives, <hi rend="bold">healthy and sick,</hi> let him be content.

passages.text: Sollicite <hi rend="spaced">quoque</hi><ptr n="7" target="ICn_8.lnote.oe.7"/> studeamus rectitudines Dei persoluere:
passages.en: Let us <hi rend="spaced">also</hi> carefully strive to pay God's dues:

passages.text: scilicet elemosinas carrucarum<ptr n="13" target="ICn_8-1.lnote.oe.13"/>, <hi rend="spaced">quam Angli uocant</hi> súlhælmesse<ptr n="1" target="ICn_8-1.lnote.oe.1-2"/>, quindecim dies post Pascha et<ptr n="2" target="ICn_8-1.lnote.oe.2"/> <hi rend="spaced">decimas pecorum et pecudum</hi> in Pentecosten, frugum <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="3" target="ICn_8-1.lnote.oe.3"/> fructuum)</seg> terrę<ptr n="4" target="ICn_8-1.lnote.oe.4"/> in festiuitate Omnium sanctorum.

notes.de: sulhelmæsse <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; sulæl. <hi rend="italic">H</hi>; sulel. <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>; sulcheimesse <hi rend="italic">S</hi>
notes.en: sulhelmæsse Cb; sulæl. H; sulel. Di; sulcheimesse S

notes.de: sicut carruca perarat [<hi rend="italic">aus</hi> 8,2] <hi rend="italic">fügt ein H Di</hi>
notes.en: sicut carruca perarat [from 8,2] inserted by H Di

passages.en: namely the plough-alms, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">súlhælmesse</hi> [plough-alms], fifteen days after Easter, and <hi rend="spaced">the tithes of cattle and small beasts</hi> at Pentecost, [and] of the crops <seg type="recension">(and fruits)</seg> of the earth at the feast of All Saints.

passages.text: Si quis decimam<ptr n="5" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.5-4"/>, sicut carruca <hi rend="spaced">perarat</hi>, dare noluerit, <hi rend="spaced">adeant</hi><ptr n="6" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.6-3"/> eum prępositus regis et prępositus episcopi, prępositus etiam domini, cuius<ptr n="7" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.7-3"/> <hi rend="bold">in capite</hi> terra est, et presbyter ęcclesię, ad <hi rend="spaced">quam</hi><ptr n="8" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.8-3"/> decima illa<ptr n="9" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.9-3"/> pertinet <seg type="recension">(eant<ptr n="10" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.10-3"/>)</seg>, et, <hi rend="bold">si aliter non possunt,</hi> ui aufe<hi rend="spaced">rant decimam et dent</hi> ęcclesię, ad quam <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">iuste</hi><ptr n="11" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.11-3"/>)</seg> pertinet; nonam<ptr n="12" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.12-2"/> autem partem dimittant<ptr n="13" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.13-2"/> illi <seg type="recension">(dent ei)</seg>, <hi rend="spaced">qui iniuste decimam</hi> <hi rend="spaced">retinuit</hi>; octo uero partes diuidantur<ptr n="14" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.14"/> inter dominum terrę et episcopum, cuiuscunque homo<ptr n="15" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.15"/> sit, regis<ptr n="16" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.16"/>, <hi rend="bold">comitis</hi> aut liberalis hominis, quem Angli þegen<ptr n="17" target="ICn_8-2.lnote.oe.17"/> uocant.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so Cb</hi>; a. e. <hi rend="italic">fehlt hier übrigen</hi> [<hi rend="italic">s. Anm.</hi> 10]
notes.en: thus Cb; a. e. missing here in the others [see note 10]

notes.de: sui, in cu. campo t. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: sui, in cu. campo t. Lb S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">hier H Di Lb</hi> [<hi rend="italic">s. Anm.</hi> 6]; <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb</hi>
notes.en: here H Di Lb [see note 6]; missing in Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="spaced">de remanente autem substantia frugum</hi> no. pa. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: <hi rend="italic">de remanente autem substantia frugum</hi> no. pa. Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">Verb fehlt H</hi>; di. i. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; ei <hi rend="italic">übrige</hi>; dent <hi rend="italic">hier Di</hi>; ei qui i. detinuit dec. dent <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: verb missing in H; di. i. Cb; ei the others; dent here Di; ei qui i. detinuit dec. dent Lb S

notes.de: aut co. aut r. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; uel r. uel c. <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>
notes.en: aut co. aut r. Cb; uel r. uel c. Lb

notes.de: the. <hi rend="italic">H T</hi>; thein <hi rend="italic">S Jo</hi>; <hi rend="italic">am Rande Cb</hi>
notes.en: the. H T; thein S Jo; in the margin Cb

passages.en: If anyone will not give the tithe, as the plough <hi rend="spaced">ploughs it</hi>, let the king's reeve and the bishop's reeve, and also the reeve of the lord whose land it is <hi rend="bold">in chief</hi>, and the priest of the church to <hi rend="spaced">which</hi> that tithe belongs <hi rend="spaced">go to</hi> him <seg type="recension">(go)</seg>, and, <hi rend="bold">if they cannot otherwise,</hi> let them by force take <hi rend="spaced">away the tithe and give it</hi> to the church to which it <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">rightfully</hi>)</seg> belongs; but let them leave the ninth part to him <seg type="recension">(give to him)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">who unjustly</hi> <hi rend="spaced">retained the tithe</hi>; and let the eight parts be divided between the lord of the land and the bishop, whosesoever man he be, the king's, an <hi rend="bold">earl's</hi> or a free man of rank's (thegn's), whom the English call <hi rend="italic">þegen</hi> [thegn].

passages.text: Pecunia <hi rend="spaced">autem</hi><ptr n="18" target="ICn_9.lnote.oe.18"/> <seg type="recension">(sancti<ptr n="11" target="ICn_9.lnote.oe.11"/>)</seg> Petri, quam<ptr n="19" target="ICn_9.lnote.oe.19"/> Angli uocant<ptr n="20" target="ICn_9.lnote.oe.20"/> Romescot, <hi rend="spaced">sit persoluta</hi> in festo sancti Petri <hi rend="bold">in principio Augusti mensis</hi> . . .<ptr n="*" target="ICn_9.lnote.oe.star"/>

notes.en: thus Cb; R. u. the others

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">folgt II Eg.</hi> 4,1—3 [<hi rend="italic">o. S.</hi> 199]; <hi rend="italic">I Cn.</hi> 12; 11; 11,1; <hi rend="italic">II Eg.</hi> 1,1; <hi rend="italic">I Cn.</hi> 10
notes.en: followed by II Eg. 4,1—3 [above p. 199]; I Cn. 12; 11; 11,1; II Eg. 1,1; I Cn. 10

passages.en: The money <hi rend="spaced">however</hi> of <seg type="recension">(Saint)</seg> Peter, which the English call <hi rend="italic">Romescot</hi> [Rome-scot], <hi rend="spaced">is to be paid</hi> on the feast of Saint Peter <hi rend="bold">at the beginning of the month of August</hi> . . .

passages.text: <ptr n="1" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.1"/>Et qui non<ptr n="2" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.2"/> eo die persoluerit, <hi rend="bold">etiam si est unus</hi><ptr n="3" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.3"/> <hi rend="bold">denarius,</hi> <hi rend="spaced">qui dare eum debuit</hi><ptr n="4" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.4"/> <hi rend="spaced">et non dedit</hi>, accipiat eundem<ptr n="5" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.5"/> et insuper triginta denarios et portet Romę; <hi rend="spaced">et cum redierit</hi>, tale signum secum<ptr n="6" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.6"/> reportet, ut<ptr n="7" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.7"/> certum sit, <hi rend="spaced">quod Romę fuerit</hi><ptr n="8" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.8"/> <hi rend="spaced">et Beato Petro ibi triginta et unum denarium, sicut statutum est</hi>, persoluerit<ptr n="9" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.9"/>; cum autem reuersus fuerit domi<ptr n="10" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.10"/>, persoluat regi <hi rend="bold">quadraginta</hi><ptr n="11" target="IIEg_4-1.lnote.incn.11"/> solidos.

notes.de: LX <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi> [<hi rend="italic">vgl. I Cn</hi> 10]

passages.en: And whoever has not paid on that day, <hi rend="bold">even if it is one</hi> <hi rend="bold">penny,</hi> <hi rend="spaced">who ought to give it</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and did not give it</hi>, let him take the same and thirty pence besides and carry it to Rome; <hi rend="spaced">and when he returns</hi>, let him bring back with him such a token that it be certain <hi rend="spaced">that he was at Rome</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and to Blessed Peter there thirty-one pence, as is decreed,</hi> has paid; and when he has come back home, let him pay the king <hi rend="bold">forty</hi> shillings.

passages.text: Si uero idem homo<ptr n="12" target="IIEg_4-2.lnote.incn.12"/> secundo hoc<ptr n="13" target="IIEg_4-2.lnote.incn.13"/> retinuerit, <hi rend="spaced">similiter omnino faciat</hi>.

notes.en: lacking in H Di Lb S

passages.en: But if the same man withholds it a second time, <hi rend="spaced">let him do entirely the same</hi>.

passages.text: Tertio autem<ptr n="14" target="IIEg_4-3.lnote.incn.14"/> si<ptr n="15" target="IIEg_4-3.lnote.incn.15"/> <hi rend="spaced">retinuerit, auferantur</hi> ei<ptr n="14" target="IIEg_4-3.lnote.incn.14"/> omnia bona<ptr n="16" target="IIEg_4-3.lnote.incn.16"/> sua.<ptr n="17" target="IIEg_4-3.lnote.incn.17"/>

notes.de: si hoc [<hi rend="italic">verlesen aus</hi> h’, <hi rend="italic">d. i.</hi> autem?] <hi rend="italic">T</hi>
notes.en: si hoc [misread from h’, i.e. autem?] T

passages.en: But if a third time he <hi rend="spaced">withholds it, let there be taken from</hi> him all his goods.

passages.text: . . . .<ptr n="11" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.11-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">Scotum ad luminaria,</hi> quod Angli <hi rend="spaced">uocant</hi> lihtgescot<ptr n="12" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.12-2"/>, ter in anno <seg type="recension">(uno<ptr n="13" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.13-2"/>)</seg> detur de unaquaque hyda <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="bold">id</hi><ptr n="14" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.14-2"/><hi rend="bold"> est suling</hi>)</seg>: cera unius oboli in uigilia Paschę, in uigilia Sanctę Marię <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="bold">in</hi><ptr n="15" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.15"/><hi rend="bold"> mense Augusto</hi>)</seg>, <ptr n="16" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.16"/><hi rend="spaced">in uigilia Omnium</hi> sanctorum . . . .<ptr n="17" target="ICn_12.lnote.oe.17"/>

notes.de: l. ter <hi rend="italic">als ein Wort Cb</hi>; lithig. <hi rend="italic">Lb Jo</hi>; lichtinges. <hi rend="italic">S</hi>; lihtscot <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>
notes.en: l. ter as one word Cb; lithig. Lb Jo; lichtinges. S; lihtscot Di

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Di Lb S</hi>; <hi rend="italic">übergeschr. H</hi>; sulinghida <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; sulinghyda <hi rend="italic">T</hi>
notes.en: missing in Di Lb S; written above H; sulinghida Cb; sulinghyda T

notes.de: in m. A. [<hi rend="italic">falsch</hi>] <hi rend="italic">fehlt Di</hi>
notes.en: in m. A. [wrong] missing in Di

passages.en: . . . . <hi rend="spaced">The scot for lights,</hi> which the English <hi rend="spaced">call</hi> <hi rend="italic">lihtgescot</hi> [light-scot], is to be given three times in the year <seg type="recension">(one)</seg> from each hide <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="bold">that is, <hi rend="italic">suling</hi></hi>)</seg>: wax worth one halfpenny on Easter Eve, on the eve of Saint Mary <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="bold">in the month of August</hi>)</seg>, <hi rend="spaced">on the eve of All</hi> Saints . . . .

passages.text: <ptr n="1" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.1-3"/>Si liberalis homo, quem <hi rend="spaced">Angli</hi><ptr n="2" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.2-3"/> þegen<ptr n="3" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.3-2"/> uocant, habet<ptr n="4" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.4-2"/> in alodio <seg type="recension">(id<ptr n="5" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.5-2"/> est bocland)</seg> suo ęcclesiam, quę habeat<ptr n="6" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.6"/> cimiterium, tertiam partem decimę proprię<ptr n="7" target="ICn_11.lnote.oe.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">terrę</hi> suę det illi ęcclesię.

notes.de: the. <hi rend="italic">H</hi>; thein <hi rend="italic">S</hi>; u. þ. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: the. H; thein S; u. þ. Cb

notes.de: i. b. <hi rend="italic">übergeschr. H</hi>; <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb Lb S</hi>
notes.en: i. b. written above H; missing in Cb Lb S

notes.de: p. t. <hi rend="italic">später am Rande Cb</hi>
notes.en: p. t. later in the margin Cb

passages.en: If a free man of rank (thegn), whom <hi rend="spaced">the English</hi> call <hi rend="italic">þegen</hi> [thegn], has on his freehold <seg type="recension">(that is <hi rend="italic">bocland</hi> [bookland])</seg> a church which has a cemetery, let him give a third part of the tithe of his own <hi rend="spaced">land</hi> to that church.

passages.text: Quodsi <hi rend="spaced">alius</hi> habet<ptr n="8" target="ICn_11-1.lnote.oe.8"/> ęcclesiam, quę cimiterium non habeat<ptr n="9" target="ICn_11-1.lnote.oe.9"/>, de <hi rend="spaced">nouem partibus bonorum suorum</hi> det ęcclesię suę . . . .<ptr n="10" target="ICn_11-1.lnote.oe.10"/>

notes.en: followed by II Eg. 1, 1 above p. 197

passages.en: But if <hi rend="spaced">another</hi> has a church which has no cemetery, let him give to his church out of <hi rend="spaced">the nine parts of his goods</hi> . . . .

passages.text: Omnes autem decimę reddantur<ptr n="1" target="IIEg_1-1.lnote.incn.1"/> <hi rend="bold">antiquis</hi> ęcclesiis, ad quas <hi rend="bold">iuste</hi><ptr n="2" target="IIEg_1-1.lnote.incn.2"/> parrochiani<ptr n="3" target="IIEg_1-1.lnote.incn.3"/> <hi rend="spaced">pertinent</hi>, tam de dominio liberalis hominis, id<ptr n="4" target="IIEg_1-1.lnote.incn.4"/> est þegnes, quam de terra uillanorum, <hi rend="spaced">id est</hi> <hi rend="bold">tunmannes</hi>, sicut carruca<ptr n="5" target="IIEg_1-1.lnote.incn.5"/> perarat.

notes.de: i. e. þ. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: i. e. þ. lacking in Lb S

passages.en: But let all tithes be rendered to the <hi rend="bold">old</hi> churches to which the parishioners <hi rend="bold">rightfully</hi> <hi rend="spaced">belong</hi>, both from the demesne of a noble, that is <hi rend="italic">þegnes</hi> [a thegn's], and from the land of villeins, <hi rend="spaced">that is</hi> <hi rend="bold"><hi rend="italic">tunmannes</hi></hi> [townsmen's], as the plough ploughs it.

passages.text: . . . . <hi rend="spaced">Omne uero</hi><ptr n="21" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.21"/> ęcclesiasticum<ptr n="22" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.22"/> donum, quod <hi rend="spaced">Angli</hi> ciricsceat<ptr n="23" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.23"/> uocant, detur antiquis<ptr n="24" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.24"/> ęcclesiis; quod sit persolutum in festiuitate sancti<ptr n="25" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.25"/> Martini; si quis ultra illum diem illud retinuerit, reddat illud<ptr n="11" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.11"/> episcopo et undecies persoluat ei et regi <hi rend="bold">quadraginta</hi><ptr n="26" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.26"/> solidos . . .<ptr n="27" target="ICn_10.lnote.oe.27"/>

notes.en: ergo, in the margin uero Cb

notes.de: u. c. <hi rend="italic">Cb T</hi>; kirchescot <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>; chercþanc <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: u. c. Cb T; kirchescot Lb S; chercþanc Cb

passages.en: . . . . <hi rend="spaced">But every</hi> church gift, which <hi rend="spaced">the English</hi> call <hi rend="italic">ciricsceat</hi> [church-scot], is to be given to the old churches; and let it be paid on the feast of Saint Martin; if anyone withholds it beyond that day, let him render it to the bishop and pay it elevenfold and to the king <hi rend="bold">forty</hi> shillings . . .

passages.text: Si quis <hi rend="spaced">corpus</hi><ptr n="18" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.18"/><hi rend="spaced"> parentis aut</hi> <hi rend="spaced">amici sui</hi> de propria parrochia <hi rend="spaced">alias portare</hi> ad<ptr n="19" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.19"/> sepeliendum uoluerit, faciat prius rectitudinem parrochię, ad quam pertinet, scilicet redditus, quod Angli saulescot<ptr n="20" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.20"/> uocant, quod recte<ptr n="21" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.21"/> <seg type="recension">(iuste)</seg> persolui debet<ptr n="22" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.22"/> ad apertum sepulchrum.<ptr n="*" target="ICn_13.lnote.oe.star"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">eine Lage ausgerissen; folgt II Cn.</hi> 15, 1 <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>
notes.en: a gathering torn out; followed by II Cn. 15, 1 Di
iu. only Cb; r. the others

notes.de: et etiam de substantia sua honoret ecclesiam suam, secundum quod ipse est; et sic cum licentia proprii presbyteri transferatur quo uoluerit <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Cb. Erster Satz von c.</hi> 14 <hi rend="italic">fehlt Inst.</hi>
notes.en: et etiam de substantia sua honoret ecclesiam suam, secundum quod ipse est; et sic cum licentia proprii presbyteri transferatur quo uoluerit added by Cb. The first sentence of c. 14 is missing in Inst.

passages.en: If anyone wishes <hi rend="spaced">to carry</hi> the <hi rend="spaced">body of his kinsman or</hi> <hi rend="spaced">friend</hi> from his own parish <hi rend="spaced">elsewhere</hi> for burial, let him first do right to the parish to which he belongs, namely the due which the English call <hi rend="italic">saulescot</hi> [soul-scot], which ought rightly <seg type="recension">(justly)</seg> to be paid at the open grave.

passages.text: Solempnitates<ptr n="23" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.23"/> <hi rend="spaced">sanctorum</hi> diligenter <seg type="recension">(ab<ptr n="24" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.24"/> omnibus)</seg> celebrentur. Et Dominici dies a <hi rend="spaced">pręcedentis</hi> Sabbati hora<ptr n="25" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.25"/> nona usque ad lucem <hi rend="spaced">sequentis</hi> ferię<ptr n="26" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.26"/> secundę feriantur; alię autem<ptr n="27" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.27"/> festiuitates et ieiunia districte custodiantur, sicut <seg type="recension">(in<ptr n="28" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.28"/> <hi rend="spaced">domo</hi><ptr n="29" target="ICn_14.lnote.oe.29"/> <hi rend="spaced">statutum</hi> est et preceptum)</seg> praecipitur.

notes.de: ab o. <hi rend="italic">nur Cb</hi>; <hi rend="italic">fehlt übrigen</hi>
notes.en: ab o. only Cb; missing in the others

notes.de: in — preceptum <hi rend="italic">nur Cb</hi>; praecipitur <hi rend="italic">übrige</hi>
notes.en: in — preceptum only Cb; praecipitur the others

notes.de: Domino <hi rend="italic">zu bessern oder</hi> Domini <hi rend="italic">zu ergänzen schlägt vor Kolderup</hi>
notes.en: Kolderup proposes correcting to Domino or supplying Domini

passages.en: Let the solemnities <hi rend="spaced">of the saints</hi> be diligently <seg type="recension">(by all)</seg> celebrated. And let Sundays be kept as holidays from the ninth hour of the <hi rend="spaced">preceding</hi> Saturday until the dawn of the <hi rend="spaced">following</hi> Monday; and let the other festivals and fasts be strictly kept, as <seg type="recension">(is <hi rend="spaced">decreed</hi> and commanded in the <hi rend="spaced">house</hi>)</seg> is commanded.

passages.text: Interdicimus <hi rend="spaced">etiam</hi><ptr n="30" target="ICn_15.lnote.oe.30"/> mercatum dierum Dominicorum et<ptr n="31" target="ICn_15.lnote.oe.31"/> omnia popularia<ptr n="1" target="ICn_15.lnote.oe.1-3"/> placita, nisi maxima<ptr n="2" target="ICn_15.lnote.oe.2-2"/> sit necessitas.

notes.en: written above Cb; missing in H

passages.en: We <hi rend="spaced">also</hi> forbid Sunday markets and all popular courts, unless there be very great necessity.

passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Opera quoque</hi> uenatoria<ptr n="3" target="ICn_15-1.lnote.oe.3"/> et omnia secularia negotia <hi rend="spaced">prohibemus</hi>.
passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">Also the works</hi> of hunting and all secular business <hi rend="spaced">we prohibit</hi>.

passages.text: Legitima etiam ieiunia et<ptr n="4" target="ICn_16.lnote.oe.4"/> <hi rend="bold">uigilię sanctorum</hi><ptr n="4" target="ICn_16.lnote.oe.4"/><hi rend="bold">,</hi> sanctę Marię scilicet et omnium<ptr n="5" target="ICn_16.lnote.oe.5-2"/> apostolorum, excepto Philippi et Iacobi propter pascalia festa, et ieiunia omnium<ptr n="6" target="ICn_16.lnote.oe.6-2"/> sextarum feriarum, nisi sit festiuitas<ptr n="7" target="ICn_16.lnote.oe.7-2"/>, <hi rend="spaced">teneantur</hi>.
passages.en: Also let the lawful fasts and the <hi rend="bold">vigils of the saints,</hi> namely of Saint Mary and of all the apostles, except Philip and James because of the Easter feasts, and the fasts of all Fridays, unless it be a festival, <hi rend="spaced">be kept</hi>.

passages.text: A Pascha tamen usque Pentecosten nullus ieiunet, nisi sit preceptum <hi rend="bold">pro</hi><ptr n="8" target="ICn_16-1.lnote.oe.8-2"/><hi rend="bold"> publica</hi> pęnitentia; a die etiam natiuitatis<ptr n="9" target="ICn_16-1.lnote.oe.9"/> Domini usque ad octauas<ptr n="10" target="ICn_16-1.lnote.oe.10"/> Epiphanię <hi rend="spaced">idem custodiatur</hi>.
passages.en: From Easter until Pentecost however let no one fast, unless it be enjoined <hi rend="bold">for public</hi> penance; and from the day of the Lord's nativity until the octave of Epiphany <hi rend="spaced">let the same be observed</hi>.

passages.text: In omnibus festis et diebus ieiuniorum et diebus Quadragesimę et ab Aduentu Domini usque<ptr n="11" target="ICn_17.lnote.oe.11-2"/> octo dies post <hi rend="bold">octauas</hi> Epiphanię et a<ptr n="12" target="ICn_17.lnote.oe.12-2"/> Septuagesima usque quindecim dies post Pasca <hi rend="spaced">omnia</hi> iudicia <hi rend="bold">ferri et aquę</hi> et <hi rend="spaced">omne</hi> iusiurandum ex <hi rend="spaced">parte Dei</hi> prohibemus.
passages.en: On all feasts and fast days and the days of Lent, and from the Lord's Advent until eight days after the <hi rend="bold">octave</hi> of Epiphany, and from Septuagesima until fifteen days after Easter, we forbid <hi rend="spaced">all</hi> ordeals <hi rend="bold">of iron and water</hi> and <hi rend="spaced">every</hi> oath <hi rend="spaced">on God's part</hi>.

passages.text: [17, 1] Sapientes<ptr n="1" target="ICn_17-1.lnote.oe.1-5"/> <hi rend="spaced">regni mei mecum</hi><ptr n="2" target="ICn_17-1.lnote.oe.2-2"/> decreuerunt celebrari<ptr n="3" target="ICn_17-1.lnote.oe.3"/> festiuitatem<ptr n="4" target="ICn_17-1.lnote.oe.4"/> sancti Eadƿardi<ptr n="5" target="ICn_17-1.lnote.oe.5"/> <hi rend="bold">regis</hi> XV. kl. Aprilis et sancti Dunstani XIIII. kl. Iunii.
passages.en: [17, 1] The wise men <hi rend="spaced">of my kingdom with me</hi> have decreed that the feast of Saint Eadƿard the <hi rend="bold">king</hi> be celebrated on the 15th day before the Kalends of April and that of Saint Dunstan on the 14th day before the Kalends of June.

passages.text: [17, 2] In his diebus sit pax et securitas omnibus Christianis, et lis <hi rend="spaced">et contentio</hi><ptr n="6" target="ICn_17-2.lnote.oe.6"/> destruatur.

notes.de: in omnibus <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Lb S</hi>
notes.en: in omnibus added by Lb S

passages.en: [17, 2] On these days let there be peace and security for all Christians, and let strife <hi rend="spaced">and contention</hi> be put down.

passages.text: [17, 3] Et si aliquis <hi rend="spaced">debet alteri pecuniam aut aliquid aliud</hi>, reddat aut ante<ptr n="7" target="ICn_17-3.lnote.oe.7-2"/> aut post<ptr n="8" target="ICn_17-3.lnote.oe.8-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">in proximo</hi>.<ptr n="9" target="ICn_17-3.lnote.oe.9"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">ausradirt, am Rande später</hi> an̄ <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> r. ante annum aut prius in pro. <hi rend="italic">S</hi>
notes.en: erased, later in the margin an̄ Cb; r. ante annum aut prius in pro. S

passages.en: [17, 3] And if anyone <hi rend="spaced">owes another money or anything else</hi>, let him pay either before or after, <hi rend="spaced">at the nearest time</hi>.

passages.text: [19] Faciamus <hi rend="spaced">etiam, sicut nobis</hi> expedit: preparemus <hi rend="spaced">nosmet ipsos et tales nos exhibeamus</hi>, ut saltem ter in anno <hi rend="spaced">possimus</hi> communicari corporis et sanguinis Domini.<ptr n="1" target="ICn_19.lnote.oe.1-2"/>

notes.en: Christi Lb S; 19, 1—21 lacking in Inst.

passages.en: [19] Let us <hi rend="spaced">also</hi> do <hi rend="spaced">as</hi> is expedient <hi rend="spaced">for us</hi>: let us prepare <hi rend="spaced">ourselves and show ourselves such</hi> that at least three times in the year we <hi rend="spaced">may be able</hi> to receive communion of the Lord's body and blood.

passages.text: [22] <hi rend="spaced">Debet etiam</hi> quisque Christianus<ptr n="1" target="ICn_22.lnote.oe.1"/> discere<ptr n="2" target="ICn_22.lnote.oe.2"/> ‘Pater noster’ et ‘Credo in <hi rend="spaced">Deum</hi>’<ptr n="3" target="ICn_22.lnote.oe.3-2"/>,
passages.en: [22] <hi rend="spaced">Also</hi> every Christian <hi rend="spaced">ought</hi> to learn the ‘Pater noster’ and the ‘Credo in <hi rend="spaced">Deum</hi>’,

passages.text: [22, 1] quia per ‘<hi rend="spaced">Pater noster</hi>’ debet <hi rend="spaced">Deum</hi> orare et per ‘<hi rend="spaced">Credo</hi> <seg type="recension">(in<ptr n="4" target="ICn_22-1.lnote.oe.4-2"/> Deum)</seg>’ fidem suam<ptr n="5" target="ICn_22-1.lnote.oe.5-2"/> ostendere.

notes.de: in D. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb Lb S</hi>
notes.en: in D. lacking in Cb Lb S

passages.en: [22, 1] because through the ‘<hi rend="spaced">Pater noster</hi>’ he ought to pray to <hi rend="spaced">God</hi> and through the ‘<hi rend="spaced">Credo</hi> <seg type="recension">(in Deum)</seg>’ show his faith.

passages.text: [22, 2] Christus ipse ‘Pater<ptr n="6" target="ICn_22-2.lnote.oe.6"/> noster’ prius cantauit et postea discipulos suos docuit.

notes.de: pr. ‘P. n.’ <hi rend="italic">Cb T;</hi> pr. c. ‘P. n.’ <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: pr. ‘P. n.’ Cb T; pr. c. ‘P. n.’ Lb S

passages.en: [22, 2] Christ himself first sang the ‘Pater noster’ and afterwards taught it to his disciples.

passages.text: [22, 3] Per ‘<hi rend="spaced">Pater noster</hi>’ enim potest quisque promereri<ptr n="7" target="ICn_22-3.lnote.oe.7"/> omne quod necessarium est in hoc sæculo et in futuro.
passages.en: [22, 3] For through the ‘<hi rend="spaced">Pater noster</hi>’ everyone can earn all that is needful in this world and in the next.

passages.text: [22, 4] Sed quomodo potest aliquis intimo corde Deum rogare, nisi habeat rectam credulitatem?
passages.en: [22, 4] But how can anyone pray to God with inmost heart unless he has right belief?

passages.text: [22, 5 <hi rend="italic">f</hi>.] <hi rend="spaced">Oportet ergo</hi>, ut post ‘Pater noster’ discat<ptr n="1" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.1-4"/> ‘<hi rend="spaced">Credo in Deum</hi>’<ptr n="2" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.2-2"/>, <hi rend="spaced">ut ostendat se Christi fidem habere</hi>. Et uere<ptr n="3" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.3"/> dico uobis<ptr n="4" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.4"/>: Non est<ptr n="5" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.5"/> perfecte<ptr n="6" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.6"/> Christianus <hi rend="spaced">nec est dignus</hi> corpus et sanguinem Domini accipere nec aliquem de baptismo leuare nec ad <hi rend="spaced">confirmandum</hi> ante episcopum ali<hi rend="spaced">quem tenere, et uere non est dignus, ut corpus eius inter corpora Christianorum sepeliatur</hi>, qui ista <hi rend="spaced">duo</hi> ignorat.<ptr n="7" target="ICn_22-5.lnote.oe.7"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">Schluss von I Cn. fehlt Inst.</hi>
notes.en: End of I Cn. lacking in Inst.

passages.en: [22, 5 <hi rend="italic">f</hi>.] <hi rend="spaced">It is fitting therefore</hi> that after the ‘Our Father’ he learn the ‘<hi rend="spaced">I believe in God</hi>’, <hi rend="spaced">so that he may show that he has the faith of Christ</hi>. And truly I say to you: he is not a perfect Christian <hi rend="spaced">nor is he worthy</hi> to receive the body and blood of the Lord, nor to lift anyone from baptism, nor for <hi rend="spaced">confirmation</hi> before the bishop to hold any<hi rend="spaced">one, and truly he is not worthy that his body be buried among the bodies of Christians</hi>, who does not know these <hi rend="spaced">two</hi>.

passages.text: Hęc<ptr n="1" target="IICn_Prol.lnote.oe.1-4"/> est etiam<ptr n="2" target="IICn_Prol.lnote.oe.2-2"/> institutio secularis, quam ego per consilium <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="3" target="IICn_Prol.lnote.oe.3-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">consensum</hi>)</seg> optimatum meorum seruare <hi rend="spaced">statui</hi><ptr n="4" target="IICn_Prol.lnote.oe.4"/> per totum regnum <hi rend="spaced">meum</hi>.

notes.en: from Cb Pl; lacking in the others

notes.de: et c. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb; aus H S Pl Ct Jo</hi>
notes.en: et c. lacking in Cb; from H S Pl Ct Jo

notes.de: per t. r. m. st. <hi rend="italic">H Lb Jo</hi>
notes.en: per t. r. m. st. H Lb Jo

passages.en: This is also the secular ordinance which I, through the counsel <seg type="recension">(and <hi rend="spaced">consent</hi>)</seg> of my magnates, <hi rend="spaced">have resolved</hi> to keep throughout all <hi rend="spaced">my</hi> kingdom.

passages.text: Inprimis, ut<ptr n="5" target="IICn_1.lnote.oe.5-2"/> iustę leges erigantur, et iniustę deprimantur et abiciantur;
passages.en: First, that just laws be raised up, and unjust ones be put down and cast away;

passages.text: recte leges<ptr n="6" target="IICn_1-1.lnote.oe.6"/> diuiti<ptr n="7" target="IICn_1-1.lnote.oe.7"/> et pauperi <hi rend="spaced">teneantur</hi>.
passages.en: that laws <hi rend="spaced">be held</hi> rightly for rich and poor.

passages.text: Quodsi <hi rend="bold">iustitia</hi><ptr n="8" target="IICn_2.lnote.oe.8"/><hi rend="bold"> sit onerosa,</hi> consideret ille mensuram ad quem pertinebit<ptr n="9" target="IICn_2.lnote.oe.9"/> tunc iusticia, sicut uult <hi rend="spaced">sibi</hi><ptr n="10" target="IICn_2.lnote.oe.10"/><hi rend="spaced"> prouideri a Deo</hi><ptr n="11" target="IICn_2.lnote.oe.11"/>, cui <hi rend="spaced">nos</hi><ptr n="5" target="IICn_2.lnote.oe.5-2"/><hi rend="spaced"> cotidie dicimus</hi>: ‘Et dimitte nobis debita nostra, sicut et nos <hi rend="spaced">dimittimus debitoribus nostris</hi>!’

notes.de: p. s. <hi rend="italic">Rl Lb Pl Ct</hi>
notes.en: p. s. Rl Lb Pl Ct

passages.en: But if <hi rend="bold">justice be burdensome,</hi> let him to whom the justice will then pertain consider the measure, as he wishes <hi rend="spaced">to be provided for by God</hi>, to whom <hi rend="spaced">we daily say</hi>: ‘And forgive us our debts, as we also <hi rend="spaced">forgive our debtors</hi>!’

passages.text: Interdicimus etiam, ne pro parua re Christiani morti tradantur, <hi rend="bold">scilicet</hi><ptr n="12" target="IICn_2-1.lnote.oe.12"/><hi rend="bold"> pro latrocinio aut pro talibus rebus,</hi> sed alio modo <hi rend="spaced">corrigantur, propter</hi><ptr n="1" target="IICn_2-1.lnote.oe.1-5"/> <hi rend="spaced">alios</hi>, <hi rend="bold">ne culpę inulte</hi><ptr n="2" target="IICn_2-1.lnote.oe.2-3"/><hi rend="bold"> remaneant.</hi>

notes.de: per <hi rend="italic">S;</hi> p. a. <hi rend="italic">am Rande Cb</hi>
notes.en: per S; p. a. in the margin Cb

passages.en: We also forbid that for a small matter Christians be delivered to death, <hi rend="bold">namely for theft or for such things,</hi> but in another way let them <hi rend="spaced">be corrected, for the sake of</hi> <hi rend="spaced">others</hi>, <hi rend="bold">lest the offences remain unpunished.</hi>

passages.text: Et <hi rend="spaced">prohibemus</hi>, ne Christiani <hi rend="spaced">gentibus</hi><ptr n="3" target="IICn_3.lnote.oe.3-4"/> extra <hi rend="spaced">hanc</hi> terram uenundentur<ptr n="4" target="IICn_3.lnote.oe.4-3"/> nec in paganismo, ne anima <hi rend="spaced">Christiana</hi>, quam ipse Christus suo<ptr n="5" target="IICn_3.lnote.oe.5-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">sanguine</hi><ptr n="*" target="IICn_3.lnote.oe.star-2"/> redemit, pereat.<ptr n="6" target="IICn_3.lnote.oe.6"/>

notes.de: e. h. t. gentilibus <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: e. h. t. gentilibus Lb S

passages.en: And we <hi rend="spaced">forbid</hi> that Christians be sold to <hi rend="spaced">heathens</hi> outside <hi rend="spaced">this</hi> land or into heathendom, lest a <hi rend="spaced">Christian</hi> soul, which Christ himself redeemed with his <hi rend="spaced">blood</hi>, perish.

passages.text: Incantatores et <hi rend="spaced">incantatrices</hi> et malefici aut<ptr n="7" target="IICn_4a.lnote.oe.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">apertę</hi> meretrices aut de regno <hi rend="spaced">nostro expellantur</hi> aut in terra <hi rend="spaced">male pereant</hi>, aut <hi rend="spaced">Deo et hominibus publice</hi> satisfaciant.<ptr n="8" target="IICn_4a.lnote.oe.8"/>
passages.en: Sorcerers and <hi rend="spaced">sorceresses</hi> and evil-doers or <hi rend="spaced">open</hi> whores either <hi rend="spaced">be expelled</hi> from <hi rend="spaced">our</hi> kingdom or <hi rend="spaced">perish miserably</hi> in the land, or make amends <hi rend="spaced">to God and men publicly</hi>.

passages.text: Interdicimus etiam omnem supersticionem paganorum,
passages.en: We also forbid all superstition of the heathens,

passages.text: uidelicet colere idola, solem, lunam, ignem, aquam, fontes, lapides<ptr n="1" target="IICn_5-1.lnote.oe.1"/>, <hi rend="spaced">lignum</hi> <hi rend="spaced">frondosum</hi><ptr n="2" target="IICn_5-1.lnote.oe.2-3"/>, lignum uiride <hi rend="bold">aut aridum</hi><ptr n="3" target="IICn_5-1.lnote.oe.3-4"/> adorare, maleficia exercere, morthrum<ptr n="4" target="IICn_5-1.lnote.oe.4-4"/> amare; <hi rend="bold">hęc </hi><seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(enim</hi><ptr n="5" target="IICn_5-1.lnote.oe.5-3"/><hi rend="bold">)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold"> omnia omni Christiano ex parte Dei prohibemus.</hi>

notes.de: li. fron. <hi rend="italic">vielleicht Glosse zu</hi> li. ui.?
notes.en: li. fron. perhaps a gloss on li. ui.?
from H; lacking in Cb Lb

passages.en: namely to worship idols, sun, moon, fire, water, springs, stones, to adore a <hi rend="spaced">leafy</hi> <hi rend="spaced">tree</hi>, a green <hi rend="bold">or dry</hi> tree, to practise sorcery, to love murder; <hi rend="bold">all these things </hi><seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(indeed)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold"> we forbid to every Christian on God's behalf.</hi>

passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Occulti</hi> homicidę, periuri, ordinum uiolatores <seg type="recension">(et<ptr n="6" target="IICn_6.lnote.oe.6"/>)</seg> nuptiarum coniugatarum, <hi rend="spaced">quos</hi><ptr n="7" target="IICn_6.lnote.oe.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">Angli uocant</hi> ǽþbrece<ptr n="8" target="IICn_6.lnote.oe.8"/>, aut <hi rend="bold">cito</hi> ad pęnitentiam <hi rend="spaced">currant</hi> aut <hi rend="bold">festinanter</hi> cum peccatis <hi rend="spaced">suis</hi> á regno nostro recedant.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt H Lb; später Cb; im Text S</hi>
notes.en: lacking in H Lb; later Cb; in the text S

notes.de: quod <hi rend="italic">Cb Lb; geändert aus</hi> quod <hi rend="italic">H</hi>
notes.en: quod Cb Lb; altered from quod H

notes.de: æðbruche <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> epebreche <hi rend="italic">Lb;</hi> epebrege <hi rend="italic">S</hi>
notes.en: æðbruche Cb; epebreche Lb; epebrege S

passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">Secret</hi> killers, perjurers, violators of holy orders <seg type="recension">(and)</seg> of married wedlock, <hi rend="spaced">whom</hi> <hi rend="spaced">the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">ǽþbrece</hi> [adulterers], let them either <hi rend="bold">quickly</hi> <hi rend="spaced">run</hi> to penance or <hi rend="bold">hastily</hi> depart with <hi rend="spaced">their</hi> sins from our kingdom.

passages.text: Adulatores, mendaces, <hi rend="spaced">pauperum</hi> spoliatores et<ptr n="9" target="IICn_7.lnote.oe.9"/> raptores <hi rend="spaced">cito</hi> iram Dei incurrant<ptr n="10" target="IICn_7.lnote.oe.10"/>, nisi <hi rend="spaced">resipiscant et cessent et Deo</hi> satisfaciant.<ptr n="11" target="IICn_7.lnote.oe.11"/>

notes.en: et r. in the margin Cb

passages.en: Flatterers, liars, despoilers <hi rend="spaced">of the poor</hi> and robbers shall <hi rend="spaced">quickly</hi> incur the wrath of God, unless they <hi rend="spaced">come to their senses and cease and to God</hi> make amends.

passages.text: Studeamus omnes omni<ptr n="1" target="IICn_8.lnote.oe.1-6"/> instantia pacem et securitatem stabilire et <hi rend="spaced">stabilitatem</hi> monetę: sic pacem et securitatem, ut prosit <hi rend="spaced">pauperibus hominibus</hi><ptr n="2" target="IICn_8.lnote.oe.2-5"/> et obsit latronibus; sic stabilitatem monetę, ut una <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">teneatur</hi><ptr n="3" target="IICn_8.lnote.oe.3-5"/> et)</seg> uadat per totam terram<ptr n="4" target="IICn_8.lnote.oe.4-4"/> <hi rend="spaced">Anglię</hi> sine falsitate, quam nullus deiciat.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so H Cb;</hi> pa. et se. o. i. <hi rend="italic">übrige</hi>
notes.en: thus H Cb; pa. et se. o. i. the others

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">nur Cb; fehlt H Lb S</hi>
notes.en: only Cb; lacking in H Lb S

notes.de: A. (<hi rend="italic">verb. aus</hi> Angliam) t. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>

passages.en: Let us all strive with all urgency to establish peace and security and <hi rend="spaced">stability</hi> of the coinage: peace and security such that it may benefit <hi rend="spaced">poor men</hi> and harm thieves; stability of the coinage such that one [coinage] <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">be held</hi> and)</seg> go throughout the whole land <hi rend="spaced">of England</hi> without falsity, which no one may reject.

passages.text: Et qui dehinc<ptr n="5" target="IICn_8-1.lnote.oe.5-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">inuentus fuerit</hi> falsum fecisse, careat manibus, cum quibus falsum<ptr n="6" target="IICn_8-1.lnote.oe.6-2"/> fecit, et nulla pecunia eas redimat, nec auro nec argento.
passages.en: And whoever henceforth <hi rend="spaced">shall be found</hi> to have made false [coin], let him lose the hands with which he made the false, and let him redeem them with no money, neither with gold nor with silver.

passages.text: Et si <hi rend="spaced">uicecomes</hi><ptr n="7" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.7-2"/> <seg type="recension">(id<ptr n="8" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.8"/> est prępositus <hi rend="spaced">ciuitatis aut uillę</hi>)</seg> calumniatus fuerit, quod <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">falsator</hi><ptr n="9" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.9"/>)</seg> per eius licentiam fecisset<ptr n="10" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.10"/> <hi rend="spaced">quod fecit</hi>, purget se triplici purgatione, <hi rend="bold">sacramenti aut igniti ferri </hi><seg type="recension"><hi rend="bold">(id</hi><ptr n="11" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.11"/><hi rend="bold"> est ordel)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold">,</hi> quod Angli <hi rend="spaced">nominant</hi> thrifealde<ptr n="12" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.12"/> lade <seg type="recension">(purgamine<ptr n="13" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.13"/>, q. A. <hi rend="spaced">uocant</hi> þrefeald l., <hi rend="bold">sa. aut i. f.,</hi> q. A. <hi rend="spaced">uocant</hi> <hi rend="bold">ordel)</hi></seg><hi rend="bold">;</hi> et si ceciderit in purgatione<ptr n="14" target="IICn_8-2.lnote.oe.14-2"/>, sustineat quod <hi rend="spaced">falsus monetarius</hi> sustinuit.

notes.de: inde ui. uel pr. <hi rend="italic">Lb;</hi> ui. meus uel pr. <hi rend="italic">S</hi>
notes.en: inde ui. uel pr. Lb; ui. meus uel pr. S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">am Rande Corrector Cb; im Text übr.</hi>
notes.en: in the margin by a corrector Cb; in the text the others
written above H; lacking in Lb S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> purgatione — lade <hi rend="italic">der übr. Hss. hat Cb</hi> purgamine — ordel
notes.en: instead of purgatione — lade of the other M S S, Cb has purgamine — ordel
