Harley 746) c. 1300; Pl (Phillipps 8078, since 1895 with H. S. Nichols & Co. in London) c. 1300; Ct (Cambridge, Trinity Coll. R 5, 42) c. 1350.

notes.de: et—emendet <hi rend="italic">am unteren Rande H, fehlt Di Lb S</hi>
notes.en: et—emendet in the lower margin H, lacking in Di Lb S

notes.de: ante e. uel c. hoc <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: ante e. uel c. hoc Cb

passages.en: . . . . Whoever fights or draws weapons before the archbishop, let him make amends with <hi rend="bold">forty</hi> shillings; <hi rend="spaced">and</hi> whoever <hi rend="spaced">does</hi> this before a bishop or an earl, let him make amends with <hi rend="bold">twenty</hi> shillings.

passages.text: Si quis uaccam aut equam, <hi rend="spaced">quam Angli uocant stodmere</hi>, et uitulum uel<ptr n="6" target="Af_16.lnote.incn.6"/> pullum <hi rend="spaced">cum eis furatus fuerit, pullum soluat</hi> <hi rend="bold">duodecim denariis</hi> <hi rend="spaced">et uitulum similiter</hi> et matres secundum pretium earum.

notes.de: et <hi rend="italic">H Di;</hi> uel p. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: et H Di; uel p. lacking in Lb S

passages.en: If anyone <hi rend="spaced">steals</hi> a cow or a mare, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call <hi rend="italic">stodmere</hi></hi>, and a calf or a foal <hi rend="spaced">with them, let him pay for the foal</hi> <hi rend="bold">with twelve pence</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and for the calf likewise</hi> and for the mothers according to their price.

passages.text: Si quis commendauerit <hi rend="spaced">aliquem</hi><ptr n="5" target="Af_17.lnote.incn.5"/> <hi rend="spaced">hominem alicui homini</hi> <hi rend="bold">non parenti</hi>, et ipse<ptr n="5" target="Af_17.lnote.incn.5"/> <hi rend="spaced">commendatus perierit in ipsa commendatione</hi>, et aliquis eum calumniauerit, <hi rend="spaced">quod dolositate eius</hi><ptr n="7" target="Af_17.lnote.incn.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">perierit</hi>, purget se . . . .
passages.en: If anyone entrusts <hi rend="spaced">some</hi> <hi rend="spaced">man to another man</hi> <hi rend="bold">not a kinsman</hi>, and the <hi rend="spaced">entrusted man himself perishes while in that keeping</hi>, and someone accuses him <hi rend="spaced">that through his treachery</hi> he <hi rend="spaced">perished</hi>, let him clear himself . . . .

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: Si quis ante comitem in placito pugnauerit, emendet secundum pretium <hi rend="bold">sui ipsius</hi> et forisfacturam, <hi rend="spaced">quod</hi><ptr n="1" target="Af_38.lnote.incn.1"/> <hi rend="spaced">Angli dicunt</hi><ptr n="2" target="Af_38.lnote.incn.2"/> ƿer<ptr n="3" target="Af_38.lnote.incn.3"/> ⁊ ƿite; et ante hoc <hi rend="spaced">soluat</hi> comiti <hi rend="bold">XL</hi> sol.
passages.en: If anyone fights before the earl at a court meeting, let him make amends according to the price <hi rend="bold">of himself</hi> and the forfeiture, <hi rend="spaced">which</hi> <hi rend="spaced">the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">ƿer</hi> ⁊ <hi rend="italic">ƿite</hi>; and before this let him <hi rend="spaced">pay</hi> the earl <hi rend="bold">XL</hi> shillings.

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Et si placitum</hi> populi erexerit, propter extractionem armorum <hi rend="spaced">suorum</hi>, <hi rend="bold">XL</hi><ptr n="1" target="Af_38-1.lnote.incn.1"/> sol. <hi rend="spaced">soluat</hi><ptr n="2" target="Af_38-1.lnote.incn.2"/> comiti.
passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">And if</hi> he stirs up <hi rend="spaced">the assembly</hi> of the people by drawing <hi rend="spaced">his</hi> weapons, let him <hi rend="spaced">pay</hi> the earl <hi rend="bold">XL</hi> shillings.

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: Si autem tale<ptr n="3" target="Af_38-2.lnote.incn.3"/> quid factum fuerit ante <hi rend="bold">uicecomitem</hi> aut ante capellanum regis, XXX sol. <hi rend="spaced">emendet</hi>.<ptr n="4" target="Af_38-2.lnote.incn.4"/>
passages.en: But if such a thing is done before the <hi rend="bold">sheriff</hi> or before the king's chaplain, let him <hi rend="spaced">make amends</hi> with XXX shillings.

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: Si quis pugnam <hi rend="spaced">inierit</hi> <hi rend="bold">in aula comitis, XX sol. emendet</hi><ptr n="4" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.4"/>, et si <hi rend="bold">hoc fit</hi> in domo hominis <hi rend="spaced">quem Angli uocant</hi> ceorl<hi rend="bold">man</hi><ptr n="5" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.5"/> <seg type="recension">(uel<ptr n="6" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.6"/> <hi rend="bold">ceorlboren</hi><ptr n="7" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.7"/>)</seg> VI sol. ei<ptr n="8" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.8"/> <hi rend="spaced">emendet</hi>.<ptr n="9" target="Af_39.lnote.incn.9"/>

notes.de: c. u. <hi rend="italic">fehlt H Lb;</hi> cherlman <hi rend="italic">im Text,</hi> man <hi rend="italic">unterpunctirt,</hi> boren <hi rend="italic">am Rande Cb</hi>
notes.en: c. u. lacking in H Lb; cherlman in the text, with man dotted for deletion and boren in the margin, Cb

passages.en: If anyone <hi rend="spaced">starts</hi> a fight <hi rend="bold">in the earl's hall, let him make amends with XX shillings</hi>, and if <hi rend="bold">this happens</hi> in the house of a man <hi rend="spaced">whom the English call</hi> ceorl<hi rend="bold">man</hi> <seg type="recension">(or <hi rend="bold">ceorlboren</hi>)</seg>, let him <hi rend="spaced">make amends</hi> to him with VI shillings.

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: Si arma extraxerit et non<ptr n="10" target="Af_39-1.lnote.incn.10"/> pugnauerit, III sol. <hi rend="spaced">emendet</hi>.<ptr n="4" target="Af_39-1.lnote.incn.4"/>
passages.en: If he draws weapons and does not fight, let him <hi rend="spaced">make amends</hi> with III shillings.

passages.incn: II 59d; e; f; g; h; i
passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Si autem hoc fit in domo hominis</hi> <hi rend="bold">quem Angli nominant</hi><ptr n="10a" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.10a"/> <hi rend="bold">radcniht,</hi> alii uero sexhende<hi rend="bold">man</hi><ptr n="11" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.11"/>, <hi rend="spaced">ter</hi><ptr n="12" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.12"/> <hi rend="spaced">carius</hi><ptr n="13" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.13"/> <hi rend="spaced">ei emendetur</hi>, <hi rend="bold">id est XVIII sol.</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">quam illi</hi> <hi rend="bold">quem supra nominauimus ceorlman.</hi><ptr n="14" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.14"/> Si <hi rend="spaced">in domo</hi> <hi rend="bold">liberalis, quem supra thegen nominauimus</hi> <hi rend="spaced">et quem</hi><ptr n="15" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.15"/> <hi rend="spaced">quidam</hi><ptr n="16" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.16"/> <hi rend="spaced">dicunt</hi><ptr n="4" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.4"/> twelfhende<hi rend="bold">man</hi><ptr n="11" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.11"/>, <hi rend="spaced">hoc fit</hi><ptr n="17" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.17"/>, dupliciter ei <hi rend="spaced">emendetur</hi> plus quam illi <hi rend="spaced">quem</hi> sexhende<hi rend="bold">man</hi><ptr n="18" target="Af_39-2.lnote.incn.18"/> <hi rend="bold">nominauimus, id est XXXVI sol.</hi> . . . .

notes.de: id est XVIII s. ca. em. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: id est XVIII s. ca. em. Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb; geänd. in</hi> quidem <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: lacking in Lb; altered to quidem Cb
Cb adds uero above the line

passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">But if this happens in the house of a man</hi> <hi rend="bold">whom the English name</hi> <hi rend="bold"><hi rend="italic">radcniht</hi>,</hi> but others <hi rend="italic">sexhende</hi><hi rend="bold">man</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">three times</hi> <hi rend="spaced">more dearly</hi> <hi rend="spaced">let amends be made to him</hi>, <hi rend="bold">that is XVIII shillings</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">than to him</hi> <hi rend="bold">whom we named above <hi rend="italic">ceorlman</hi>.</hi> If <hi rend="spaced">in the house</hi> <hi rend="bold">of a man of rank, whom we named above thegen,</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and whom</hi> <hi rend="spaced">some</hi> <hi rend="spaced">call</hi> twelfhende<hi rend="bold">man</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">this happens</hi>, doubly <hi rend="spaced">let amends be made</hi> to him, more than to him <hi rend="spaced">whom</hi> <hi rend="bold">we named</hi> <hi rend="italic">sexhende</hi><hi rend="bold">man</hi>, <hi rend="bold">that is XXXVI shillings</hi> . . . .

passages.text: . . . Si quis exarmauerit<ptr n="12" target="IICn_60.lnote.oe.12-2"/> hominem<ptr n="13" target="IICn_60.lnote.oe.13-2"/> contra iusticiam, <hi rend="bold">X</hi><ptr n="14" target="IICn_60.lnote.oe.14-2"/><hi rend="bold"> sol.</hi> ei emendet; et si ligatus fuerit, medietas pretii eius, <hi rend="spaced">quod Angli dicunt</hi> be healue þere<ptr n="15" target="IICn_60.lnote.oe.15-2"/>, ei persoluatur.

notes.en: lacking in H Di Lb S

passages.en: . . . If anyone disarms a man against justice, let him make amends to him with <hi rend="bold">X shillings</hi>; and if he is bound, let half his price, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> be healue <hi rend="italic">þere</hi>, be paid to him.

passages.text: Si quis <hi rend="spaced">in bello</hi> pacem fregerit, <hi rend="spaced">quod Angli dicunt</hi> griþbrece<ptr n="16" target="IICn_61.lnote.oe.16"/>, reus est mortis aut prętii sui.<ptr n="17" target="IICn_61.lnote.oe.17-2"/>
passages.en: If anyone breaks the peace <hi rend="spaced">in war</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">griþbrece</hi>, he is guilty of death or of his price.

passages.text: Si quis inuasionem domus <hi rend="spaced">aut</hi> curię fecerit, quod<ptr n="18" target="IICn_62.lnote.oe.18-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">Angli</hi> <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">dicunt</hi><ptr n="19" target="IICn_62.lnote.oe.19"/>)</seg> hamsocne <hi rend="spaced">uocant</hi>, quinque libras regi emendet.

notes.de: di. h. <hi rend="italic">Cb Lb;</hi> h. uo. <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>
notes.en: di. h. Cb Lb; h. uo. H Di

passages.en: If anyone makes an attack on a house <hi rend="spaced">or</hi> a court, which <hi rend="spaced">the English</hi> <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">say</hi>)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">call</hi> <hi rend="italic">hamsocne</hi>, let him make amends to the king with five pounds.

passages.text: Et si in illa <hi rend="spaced">inuasione</hi> occisus fuerit, iaceat impersolutus, <hi rend="spaced">quod Angli dicunt</hi> ægelde.<ptr n="20" target="IICn_62-1.lnote.oe.20"/>
passages.en: And if he is killed in that <hi rend="spaced">attack</hi>, let him lie unpaid for, <hi rend="spaced">which the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">ægelde</hi>.

passages.text: Si quis rapinam fecerit, soluat et persoluat, et sit<ptr n="1" target="IICn_63.lnote.oe.1-5"/> reus pretii sui contra regem.
passages.en: If anyone commits robbery, let him give back and pay compensation, and be liable for his price to the king.

passages.text: Destructio domus et combustio <hi rend="spaced">illius</hi><ptr n="2" target="IICn_64.lnote.oe.2-2"/> et <hi rend="spaced">publicus latro</hi> et mordrum<ptr n="3" target="IICn_64.lnote.oe.3-4"/> et <hi rend="spaced">insidiator</hi><ptr n="4" target="IICn_64.lnote.oe.4-4"/> proprii <hi rend="spaced">domini</hi><ptr n="5" target="IICn_64.lnote.oe.5-4"/> <seg type="recension">(traditor)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">transeunt</hi> omnem emendationem nec <hi rend="spaced">aliquam</hi> habent.

notes.de: illarum <hi rend="italic">H Di;</hi> <hi rend="spaced">uillarum</hi> <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: illarum H Di; <hi rend="italic">uillarum</hi> Lb S

notes.de: ins. <hi rend="italic">H Di Lb S;</hi> trad. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: ins. H Di Lb S; trad. Cb

passages.en: Destruction of a house and burning <hi rend="spaced">of it</hi> and <hi rend="spaced">a public thief</hi> and murder and <hi rend="spaced">a plotter against</hi> his own <hi rend="spaced">lord</hi> <seg type="recension">(traitor)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">go beyond</hi> all amends, nor do they have <hi rend="spaced">any</hi>.

passages.text: Si quis neglexerit emendationem ciuitatis uel pontis<ptr n="6" target="IICn_65.lnote.oe.6"/> aut ire ad <hi rend="spaced">bellum</hi>, soluat regi <hi rend="bold">XL</hi><ptr n="7" target="IICn_65.lnote.oe.7-3"/> solidos; aut ita sé purget: nominentur ei quattuordecim, et adquirat undecim et<ptr n="8" target="IICn_65.lnote.oe.8-3"/> <hi rend="spaced">ipse</hi><ptr n="9" target="IICn_65.lnote.oe.9-3"/><hi rend="spaced"> sit duodecimus</hi>.
passages.en: If anyone neglects the repair of a town or a bridge or going to <hi rend="spaced">war</hi>, let him pay the king <hi rend="bold">XL</hi> shillings; or let him clear himself thus: let fourteen be named for him, and let him obtain eleven and <hi rend="spaced">himself be the twelfth</hi>.

passages.text: Si quis Godes<ptr n="12" target="IICn_66.lnote.oe.12-2"/> flyman iniuste habuerit, reddat eum ad iusticiam et persoluat <hi rend="bold">despectum</hi> cui iustum<ptr n="13" target="IICn_66.lnote.oe.13-2"/> est; et regi emendet pretium, id <hi rend="spaced">est be</hi> þere.<ptr n="14" target="IICn_66.lnote.oe.14-2"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">aus H;</hi> G. f. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Di Cb Lb S</hi>
notes.en: from H; G. f. lacking in Di Cb Lb S

passages.en: If anyone unjustly harbours <hi rend="italic">Godes flyman</hi> [God's fugitive], let him deliver him to justice and pay the <hi rend="bold">contempt-fine</hi> to whom it is due; and to the king let him pay amends of his price, that <hi rend="spaced">is be</hi> <hi rend="italic">þere</hi>.

passages.text: Si quis secum tenuerit excommunicatum aut exulem <hi rend="spaced">clamatum, careat omnibus</hi> bonis<ptr n="10" target="IICn_66-1.lnote.oe.10"/> suis et uita, <hi rend="bold">nisi ei</hi><ptr n="11" target="IICn_66-1.lnote.oe.11"/><hi rend="bold"> rex parcat.</hi>
passages.en: If anyone keeps with him an excommunicate or a <hi rend="spaced">proclaimed</hi> outlaw, <hi rend="spaced">let him lose all</hi> his goods and his life, <hi rend="bold">unless the king spares him.</hi>

passages.text: Hęc<ptr n="1" target="IICn_69.lnote.oe.1-6"/> est alleuiatio, quam ego uolo fieri<ptr n="2" target="IICn_69.lnote.oe.2-4"/> omni populo, unde<ptr n="3" target="IICn_69.lnote.oe.3-3"/> hactenus ultra modum fuerunt grauati.

notes.en: Hęc — grau. in red Lb S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">übergeschr. H; fehlt Di Lb Jo;</hi> o. p. f. <hi rend="italic">Cb Rl</hi>
notes.en: written above in H; lacking in Di Lb Jo; o. p. f. Cb Rl

notes.de: ut nullatenus sint <hi rend="italic">Lb S Jo</hi>
notes.en: ut nullatenus sint Lb S Jo

passages.en: This is the relief which I wish to be made for all the people, in which hitherto they have been burdened beyond measure.

passages.text: Hoc est<ptr n="4" target="IICn_69-1.lnote.oe.4-2"/> inprimis: pręcipio omnibus prępositis meis, ut in propriis <hi rend="bold">uillis</hi> meis bene et <hi rend="spaced">pleniter</hi> arent et <hi rend="bold">seminent et culturas optime colant</hi> et inde me et <hi rend="spaced">meos</hi> pascant, et a nullo aliquid <hi rend="bold">iniuste extorqueant,</hi> unde me pascere possint<ptr n="5" target="IICn_69-1.lnote.oe.5-3"/> <seg type="recension">(debeant)</seg>, nisi quis sponte et <hi rend="spaced">uoluntarie</hi><ptr n="6" target="IICn_69-1.lnote.oe.6-2"/> eis<ptr n="7" target="IICn_69-1.lnote.oe.7-2"/> aliquod auxilium prębere uoluerit.

notes.de: po. <hi rend="italic">H Di Lb S;</hi> de. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: po. H Di Lb S; de. Cb

passages.en: This is first: I command all my reeves that on my own <hi rend="bold">estates</hi> they plough well and <hi rend="spaced">fully</hi> and <hi rend="bold">sow and cultivate the fields excellently</hi> and from that feed me and <hi rend="spaced">mine</hi>, and from no one <hi rend="bold">unjustly extort</hi> anything with which they could <seg type="recension">(should)</seg> feed me, unless someone of his own accord and <hi rend="spaced">willingly</hi> wishes to offer them some help.

passages.text: Quodsi aliquis dehinc forisfacturam aliquam exegerit ab aliquo, <hi rend="bold">qui eos adiuuare ad hoc noluerit,</hi> pretium suum, <hi rend="spaced">id est</hi> þere, regi <hi rend="spaced">persoluat</hi>.
passages.en: But if anyone henceforth exacts any forfeiture from someone <hi rend="bold">who would not help them in this,</hi> let him <hi rend="spaced">pay</hi> his price, <hi rend="spaced">that is</hi> <hi rend="italic">þere</hi>, to the king.

passages.text: Si quis obmutescit, <hi rend="spaced">antequam</hi> ex hac uita exeat, seu<ptr n="8" target="IICn_70.lnote.oe.8"/> per neglegentiam seu per subitam mortem, dominus eius nichil se intromittat de omnibus bonis illius<ptr n="9" target="IICn_70.lnote.oe.9-2"/>, nisi quantum ad eum iuste <hi rend="spaced">pertinet</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">hoc est tantum quod Angli uocant</hi><ptr n="10" target="IICn_70.lnote.oe.10-2"/> heregeate.<ptr n="11" target="IICn_70.lnote.oe.11-2"/>

notes.de: herg. <hi rend="italic">H Di;</hi> heregeat <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> heregete <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: herg. H Di; heregeat Cb; heregete Lb S

passages.en: If anyone falls dumb <hi rend="spaced">before</hi> he goes out of this life, whether through negligence or through sudden death, let his lord not meddle at all with any of his goods, except as much as rightly <hi rend="spaced">belongs</hi> to him, <hi rend="spaced">that is, just what the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">heregeate</hi>.

passages.text: Sed omnia illius <hi rend="spaced">diuidantur</hi> secundum ordinationem suam mulieri et<ptr n="12" target="IICn_70-1.lnote.oe.12"/> infantibus<ptr n="13" target="IICn_70-1.lnote.oe.13"/> et parentibus <hi rend="spaced">suis</hi>.
passages.en: But let all his things <hi rend="spaced">be divided</hi> according to his disposition among wife and children and <hi rend="spaced">his</hi> kinsmen.

passages.text: Et illud debitum, quod heregeat supra<ptr n="12" target="IICn_71.lnote.oe.12"/> <hi rend="spaced">nominauimus</hi>, ita conuenienter pręparetur, secundum quod <hi rend="bold">natus est:</hi>
passages.en: And that due, which above we <hi rend="spaced">named</hi> <hi rend="italic">heregeat</hi>, let it be suitably prepared thus, according to what <hi rend="bold">he was born [to]:</hi>

passages.text: Comitis, sicut <hi rend="spaced">decet</hi><ptr n="14" target="IICn_71a.lnote.oe.14"/><hi rend="spaced"> comiti</hi>, id est octo equos, IIII cum sellis et quattuor sine sellis, IIII<ptr n="1" target="IICn_71a.lnote.oe.1-3"/> galeas et quattuor loricas, octo lanceas et totidem scuta et <hi rend="bold">quinquaginta</hi><ptr n="*" target="IICn_71a.lnote.oe.star"/> mancas<ptr n="2" target="IICn_71a.lnote.oe.2-3"/> auri.

notes.de: g. IIII et lo. IIII et la. VIII <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>
notes.en: g. IIII et lo. IIII et la. VIII Lb

passages.en: Of an earl, as <hi rend="spaced">befits an earl</hi>, that is eight horses, IIII with saddles and four without saddles, IIII helmets and four mail-coats, eight lances and as many shields and <hi rend="bold">fifty</hi> mancuses of gold.

passages.text: Mediocris hominis, <hi rend="bold">quem</hi><ptr n="10" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.10"/><hi rend="bold"> Angli dicunt læsseþegen</hi><ptr n="11" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.11-2"/><hi rend="bold">,</hi> illius <hi rend="spaced">heregeat</hi><ptr n="12" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.12"/> est: equus et<ptr n="13" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.13"/> arma aut halsfang, <hi rend="spaced">quod est</hi><ptr n="14" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.14-2"/> <hi rend="bold">X</hi><ptr n="15" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.15-2"/><hi rend="bold"> solidi,</hi> in þeassexe<ptr n="16" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.16-2"/>; in Mercia <hi rend="spaced">uero</hi> et in Eastengle<ptr n="17" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.17"/> duę librę <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">denariorum</hi><ptr n="18" target="IICn_71-2.lnote.oe.18"/>)</seg>.

notes.de: les. <hi rend="italic">Cb;</hi> lees. <hi rend="italic">S;</hi> leessete., eius <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>
notes.en: les. Cb; lees. S; leessete., eius Lb

passages.en: Of a middling man, <hi rend="bold">whom the English call <hi rend="italic">læsseþegen</hi>,</hi> his <hi rend="spaced"><hi rend="italic">heregeat</hi></hi> is: a horse and arms or <hi rend="italic">halsfang</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">which is</hi> <hi rend="bold">X shillings,</hi> in þeassexe [Wessex]; in Mercia <hi rend="spaced">however</hi> and in Eastengle [East Anglia] two pounds <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">of pence</hi>)</seg>.

passages.text: <ptr n="3" target="IICn_71-3.lnote.oe.3-3"/>Liberalis hominis<ptr n="4" target="IICn_71-3.lnote.oe.4"/> qui habet consuetudines suas<ptr n="5" target="IICn_71-3.lnote.oe.5"/>, <hi rend="spaced">quem Angli dicunt</hi> kinges þegen, debitum <hi rend="spaced">post mortem eius</hi>, quod supra <hi rend="spaced">nominauimus</hi> heregeat: IIII librę<ptr n="6" target="IICn_71-3.lnote.oe.6-2"/>;

notes.en: homo, in the margin hominis Cb

passages.en: Of a free man of rank (thegn) who has his customs, <hi rend="spaced">whom the English call</hi> kinges <hi rend="italic">þegen</hi>, the due <hi rend="spaced">after his death</hi>, which above we <hi rend="spaced">named</hi> <hi rend="italic">heregeat</hi>: IIII pounds;

passages.text: et, si notus fuerit regi: duos equos, unus<ptr n="7" target="IICn_71-4.lnote.oe.7"/> cum sella et alius sine, gladium unum et duas lanceas et duo scuta et quinquaginta mancas<ptr n="2" target="IICn_71-4.lnote.oe.2"/> auri;
passages.en: and, if he was known to the king: two horses, one with a saddle and the other without, one sword and two lances and two shields and fifty mancuses of gold;

passages.text: et qui tantum non <seg type="recension">(habet<ptr n="8" target="IICn_71-5.lnote.oe.8"/> uel)</seg> potest<ptr n="9" target="IICn_71-5.lnote.oe.9"/>, XL <hi rend="spaced">solidos</hi>.<ptr n="**" target="IICn_71-5.lnote.oe.star2"/>

notes.de: h. u. <hi rend="italic">nur Cb</hi> [<hi rend="italic">vgl. Hs. B</hi>]; <hi rend="italic">fehlt übr.</hi>
notes.en: h. u. only Cb [cf. M S B]; lacking in the others

passages.en: and he who cannot <seg type="recension">(has not or)</seg> [pay] so much: XL <hi rend="spaced">shillings</hi>.

passages.text: Ubi <hi rend="spaced">homo</hi> sine aliqua calumpnia, aut<ptr n="19" target="IICn_72.lnote.oe.19"/> de <hi rend="spaced">terra</hi> <hi rend="bold">aut de alia re,</hi> moritur, uxor eius et pueri remaneant <hi rend="spaced">similiter</hi>.
passages.en: Where a <hi rend="spaced">man</hi> dies without any claim [against him], either concerning <hi rend="spaced">land</hi> <hi rend="bold">or concerning another thing,</hi> his wife and children shall remain <hi rend="spaced">likewise</hi> [undisturbed].

passages.text: Si autem uir<ptr n="20" target="IICn_72-1.lnote.oe.20"/> ante mortem proclamatus <hi rend="spaced">de talibus fuit</hi>, oportet ut <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">eius</hi><ptr n="1" target="IICn_72-1.lnote.oe.1-4"/>)</seg> heredes<ptr n="2" target="IICn_72-1.lnote.oe.2"/> secundum <hi rend="spaced">iusticiam</hi> respondeant, sicut ipse deberet, si uiueret.

notes.de: heres s. i. respondeat <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: heres s. i. respondeat Lb S

passages.en: But if the man before his death was <hi rend="spaced">accused of such things</hi>, it is necessary that <seg type="recension">(<hi rend="spaced">his</hi>)</seg> heirs answer according to <hi rend="spaced">justice</hi>, as he himself would have had to, if he were alive.

passages.text: Et<ptr n="3" target="IICn_73.lnote.oe.3-2"/> uidua per<ptr n="4" target="IICn_73.lnote.oe.4-2"/> integrum annum sine uiro permaneat.

notes.de: uxor eius <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Lb S</hi>
notes.en: uxor eius added by Lb S

notes.de: unum <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> p. i. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: unum instead of p. i. Lb S

passages.en: And the widow shall remain without a husband for an entire year.

passages.text: Quę si ante<ptr n="5" target="IICn_73a.lnote.oe.5-4"/> annum aliter fecerit <seg type="recension">(nupserit<ptr n="6" target="IICn_73a.lnote.oe.6-4"/>)</seg>, careat dote et omnibus bonis, quę habuit per primum uirum; et proximi paren<hi rend="spaced">tes prioris uiri</hi> habeant terras et <hi rend="spaced">alia omnia</hi>, quę illa <hi rend="spaced">iuste perdidit</hi>.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so statt</hi> a. f. <hi rend="italic">S;</hi> alterum nu. <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>
notes.en: thus instead of a. f. S; alterum nu. Lb

passages.en: If she before the year does otherwise <seg type="recension">(marries)</seg>, she shall lose her dower and all the goods which she had through her first husband; and the nearest <hi rend="spaced">kinsmen of the former husband</hi> shall have the lands and <hi rend="spaced">all other things</hi> which she <hi rend="spaced">has justly lost</hi>.

passages.text: Uir autem post acceptus sit reus prętii sui contra regem aut contra eum, cui hoc<ptr n="7" target="IICn_73-1.lnote.oe.7"/> rex concesserit.<ptr n="8" target="IICn_73-1.lnote.oe.8"/>
passages.en: But the man afterwards accepted shall be liable for his own price [wergeld] to the king or to him to whom the king has granted this.

passages.text: Et quamuis coacta fuisset<ptr n="9" target="IICn_73-2.lnote.oe.9-2"/> il<hi rend="spaced">lum accipere</hi>, nisi ab<ptr n="10" target="IICn_73-2.lnote.oe.10-2"/> illo omnino recedat, ita ut eius nunquam amplius<ptr n="11" target="IICn_73-2.lnote.oe.11"/> fiat, careat om<hi rend="spaced">nium supra</hi><ptr n="12" target="IICn_73-2.lnote.oe.12"/><hi rend="spaced"> dictorum</hi> bonorum.
passages.en: And although she had been forced to <hi rend="spaced">accept him</hi>, unless she withdraws from him entirely, so that she never again becomes his, she shall lose <hi rend="spaced">all the above-mentioned</hi> goods.

passages.text: Et tamen <hi rend="spaced">interdicimus</hi>, ne uidua ultra modum cito ueletur.
passages.en: And yet we <hi rend="spaced">forbid</hi> that a widow be veiled too hastily.

passages.text: Sed persoluat redditum<ptr n="13" target="IICn_73-4.lnote.oe.13"/> do<hi rend="spaced">mino suo, quod supra</hi> heregeat<ptr n="14" target="IICn_73-4.lnote.oe.14"/> <hi rend="spaced">nominauimus</hi>, infra duodecim menses, nisi ei<ptr n="15" target="IICn_73-4.lnote.oe.15"/> ante oportunum<ptr n="16" target="IICn_73-4.lnote.oe.16-2"/> fuerit.
passages.en: But she shall pay the due to her <hi rend="spaced">lord, which above</hi> we <hi rend="spaced">have named</hi> <hi rend="italic">heregeat</hi> [heriot], within twelve months, unless it is convenient for her earlier.

passages.text: Nemo cogat mulierem aut uir<hi rend="spaced">ginem contra uoluntatem illarum</hi><ptr n="17" target="IICn_74.lnote.oe.17"/>, quod eis displiceat, nec pro pecunia <hi rend="spaced">nec pro alia re</hi>, nisi quis<ptr n="18" target="IICn_74.lnote.oe.18-2"/> sponte quid dare uoluerit.
passages.en: Let no one force a woman or a <hi rend="spaced">maiden against their will</hi> to what displeases them, neither for money <hi rend="spaced">nor for any other thing</hi>, unless someone of his own accord wishes to give something.

passages.text: Si quis lanceam suam ad hostium<ptr n="1" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.1-6"/> alicuius posuerit et intrauerit domum <hi rend="spaced">aliqua de causa</hi>, aut si alicubi <hi rend="spaced">inuenerit</hi> arma iacere in aliquo <hi rend="spaced">secreto</hi> loco, ubi sine offensione esse possent, si dimitterentur, et<ptr n="2" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.2-6"/> ille posuerit ibi<ptr n="3" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.3-5"/> lanceam suam, et alius eam inde rapiat<ptr n="4" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.4-5"/> et aliquid mali cum<ptr n="5" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.5-4"/> illa faciat, tunc rectum est, ut ipse<ptr n="6" target="IICn_75.lnote.oe.6-3"/> qui <hi rend="spaced">cum lancea malum fecerit</hi>, ipse malum emendet.

notes.de: et—suam [<hi rend="italic">Wiederholung des Anfangs</hi>] <hi rend="italic">vielleicht nicht original</hi>
notes.en: et—suam [repetition of the beginning] perhaps not original

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">übergeschr. H</hi>; p. i. l. <hi rend="italic">am Rande Corrector Cb's und ebenso im Texte auf Rasur</hi>
notes.en: written above H; p. i. l. in the margin by Cb's corrector and likewise in the text on an erasure

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so H</hi>; rapuerit <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>; rapit <hi rend="italic">übr.</hi>
notes.en: thus H; rapuerit Di; rapit the others

passages.en: If anyone has set his lance at someone's door and has entered the house <hi rend="spaced">for some reason</hi>, or if somewhere he <hi rend="spaced">has found</hi> weapons lying in some <hi rend="spaced">secluded</hi> place, where they could be without harm if they were left alone, and he has put his lance there, and another seizes it from there and does some harm with it, then it is right that he himself who <hi rend="spaced">did harm with the lance</hi>, he himself make amends for the harm.

passages.text: Et ille qui <hi rend="spaced">lanceam posuit</hi>, ubi sine <hi rend="spaced">lesione</hi> iacere<ptr n="7" target="IICn_75-1.lnote.oe.7-2"/> po<hi rend="spaced">tuisset, si dimitteretur</hi>, purget se, si audet, quod non fuit eius uoluntate nec potestate nec consilio nec<ptr n="8" target="IICn_75-1.lnote.oe.8-2"/> testimonio eius <hi rend="spaced">malum factum quod actum</hi><ptr n="9" target="IICn_75-1.lnote.oe.9-3"/> est: erit tunc rectum secundum <hi rend="spaced">iusticiam</hi>, ut ipse sit<ptr n="10" target="IICn_75-1.lnote.oe.10-3"/> inculpabilis.

notes.en: written above H; inc. sit Di

passages.en: And he who <hi rend="spaced">put the lance</hi> where it <hi rend="spaced">could have</hi> lain without <hi rend="spaced">injury</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">if it were left alone</hi>, shall clear himself, if he dares, that it was not by his will nor power nor counsel nor his witness that <hi rend="spaced">the harm which was done was done</hi>: it will then be right according to <hi rend="spaced">justice</hi> that he be blameless.

passages.text: Et malefactor <hi rend="spaced">malum</hi><ptr n="11" target="IICn_75-2.lnote.oe.11-3"/> quod fecit emendet, secundum<ptr n="12" target="IICn_75-2.lnote.oe.12-3"/> quod lex docet.

notes.de: s. q. l. d. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb</hi>
notes.en: s. q. l. d. lacking in Cb

passages.en: And the wrongdoer shall make amends for the <hi rend="spaced">harm</hi> which he did, according as the law teaches.

passages.text: Si quis aliquid <hi rend="spaced">furtiuum</hi><ptr n="13" target="IICn_76.lnote.oe.13-3"/> ad domum suam portet, et patefac<hi rend="spaced">tum fuerit</hi>, iustum est, ut habeat quod quesiuit.
passages.en: If anyone carries something <hi rend="spaced">stolen</hi> to his house, and it <hi rend="spaced">has been</hi> discovered, it is just that he have what he sought.

passages.text: Et nisi illud <hi rend="spaced">furtum inuentum</hi> fuerit<ptr n="14" target="IICn_76-1.lnote.oe.14"/> sub clauibus mulieris, sit<ptr n="15" target="IICn_76-1.lnote.oe.15"/> illa immunis.

notes.de: s. i. i. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: s. i. i. lacking in Lb S

passages.en: And unless the <hi rend="spaced">stolen thing is found</hi> under the woman's keys, she shall be free [of guilt].

passages.text: Has uero <hi rend="spaced">claues mulier</hi> debet sub cura sua custodire, scilicet dispensę<ptr n="1" target="IICn_76-1a.lnote.oe.1-5"/> suę et arcę et scrinii sui; sub his <hi rend="spaced">itaque clauibus</hi> si <hi rend="spaced">inuentum</hi><ptr n="2" target="IICn_76-1a.lnote.oe.2-4"/><hi rend="spaced"> non fuerit</hi>, mulier sine culpa erit.<ptr n="3" target="IICn_76-1a.lnote.oe.3-3"/>
passages.en: These <hi rend="spaced">keys</hi>, however, <hi rend="spaced">the woman</hi> must keep under her care, namely of her storeroom and her chest and her casket; under these <hi rend="spaced">keys, therefore,</hi> if it <hi rend="spaced">has not been found</hi>, the woman will be without blame.

passages.text: Hactenus <hi rend="spaced">habita</hi><ptr n="4" target="IICn_76-2.lnote.oe.4-3"/> est <hi rend="spaced">quędam</hi><ptr n="5" target="IICn_76-2.lnote.oe.5-3"/> <hi rend="spaced">praua</hi><ptr n="6" target="IICn_76-2.lnote.oe.6-3"/> consuetudo in <hi rend="spaced">hac</hi><ptr n="7" target="IICn_76-2.lnote.oe.7-2"/> terra, quia pueri qui iacebant in cunis, quanuis adhuc<ptr n="8" target="IICn_76-2.lnote.oe.8-2"/> nullo cibo uterentur, iudicabantur ab auaris ęque rei, ac si scientiam haberent.

notes.en: <hi rend="italic">Anglia</hi> instead of h. t. Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">am Rande Cb's Corrector</hi>; <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: in the margin by Cb's corrector; lacking in Lb S

passages.en: Until now there <hi rend="spaced">has been</hi> <hi rend="spaced">a certain</hi> <hi rend="spaced">wicked</hi> custom in <hi rend="spaced">this</hi> land, that children who lay in cradles, although they did not yet take any food, were judged by the greedy equally guilty, as if they had understanding.

passages.text: Sed ego hoc omnibus modis <hi rend="spaced">interdico</hi> et multa alia, quę ualde<ptr n="9" target="IICn_76-3.lnote.oe.9-2"/> sunt<ptr n="10" target="IICn_76-3.lnote.oe.10-2"/> Deo contraria.

notes.de: sint <hi rend="italic">Di</hi>; D. c. s. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; D. s. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: sint Di; D. c. s. Cb; D. s. Lb S

passages.en: But I <hi rend="spaced">forbid</hi> this in every way, and many other things which are very contrary to God.

passages.text: Si quis timore <hi rend="spaced">perterritus</hi> a domino suo aut a <hi rend="spaced">sociis suis</hi> fugerit de bello siue in terra sive in mari<ptr n="11" target="IICn_77.lnote.oe.11-2"/> <seg type="recension">(aqua)</seg>, careat omnium<ptr n="12" target="IICn_77.lnote.oe.12-2"/> bonorum suorum cum uita; et dominus <seg type="recension">(suus<ptr n="13" target="IICn_77.lnote.oe.13-2"/>)</seg> accipiat omnia que<ptr n="13" target="IICn_77.lnote.oe.13-2"/> illius sunt<ptr n="13" target="IICn_77.lnote.oe.13-2"/> et terram, si quam ei antea dedisset.

notes.de: c. u. o. b. s. <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>; omnibus bonis suis simul c. <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>
notes.en: c. u. o. b. s. H Di; omnibus bonis suis simul c. Lb
from Cb; lacking in the others

passages.en: If anyone, <hi rend="spaced">terrified</hi> by fear, flees from his lord or from <hi rend="spaced">his comrades</hi> out of battle, whether on land or on sea <seg type="recension">(water)</seg>, he shall lose all his goods along with his life; and the <seg type="recension">(his)</seg> lord shall take all things that are his, and the land, if he had given him any before.

passages.text: Si autem habuerit<ptr n="14" target="IICn_77-1.lnote.oe.14"/> <hi rend="spaced">alodium</hi>, sit regis.
passages.en: But if he has <hi rend="spaced">allodial land</hi>, it shall be the king's.

passages.text: Si quis uero ceciderit ante dominum suum in bello siue in patria<ptr n="15" target="IICn_78.lnote.oe.15-2"/> siue extra patriam, <hi rend="spaced">redditus domini sui</hi><ptr n="16" target="IICn_78.lnote.oe.16-2"/>, scilicet <seg type="recension">(quem <hi rend="spaced">supra nominauimus</hi>)</seg> heregeat<ptr n="17" target="IICn_78.lnote.oe.17"/>, perdonetur <hi rend="bold">uxori eius uel heredibus</hi><ptr n="18" target="IICn_78.lnote.oe.18-2"/><hi rend="bold">;</hi> heredes autem habeant omnia eius cum terris et iuste diuidant.

notes.de: bello, <hi rend="italic">am Rande vom Corr.</hi> patria <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>
notes.en: bello, in the margin by the corrector patria Cb

notes.de: sui sc. <hi rend="italic">Cb</hi>; <hi rend="italic">dafür</hi> q. s. n. <hi rend="italic">übr.</hi>
notes.en: sui sc. Cb; in its place q. s. n. the others

passages.en: But if anyone falls before his lord in battle, whether in the country or outside the country, <hi rend="spaced">his lord's due</hi>, namely <seg type="recension">(which we <hi rend="spaced">named above</hi>)</seg> <hi rend="italic">heregeat</hi> [heriot], shall be remitted <hi rend="bold">to his wife or heirs;</hi> and the heirs shall have all his things with the lands and divide them justly.

passages.text: Quisquis terram suam iuste defenderit teste comitatu, possideat sine calumnia, dum uiuit, et si placuerit sibi<ptr n="1" target="IICn_79.lnote.oe.1-5"/> eam uendere<ptr n="2" target="IICn_79.lnote.oe.2-4"/> aut dare, det cuicunque ei<ptr n="3" target="IICn_79.lnote.oe.3-4"/> libuerit.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">am Rande vom Corrector Cb</hi>; illi <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: in the margin by the corrector of Cb; illi Lb S

passages.en: Whoever has justly defended his land with the shire (court) as witness shall possess it without claim while he lives, and if it pleases him to sell or give it, let him give it to whomever he pleases.

passages.text: Uolo etiam, ut omnis homo habeat uenationem suam in siluis et in planis super sua.
passages.en: I will also that every man have his hunting in the woods and in the open country on his own [land].

passages.text: Et omnes<ptr n="4" target="IICn_80-1.lnote.oe.4"/> deuitent meam, ubicunque illam<ptr n="5" target="IICn_80-1.lnote.oe.5-2"/> habere<ptr n="6" target="IICn_80-1.lnote.oe.6-2"/> uoluero.<ptr n="7" target="IICn_80-1.lnote.oe.7-2"/>

notes.de: h. i. <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>; <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S</hi>
notes.en: h. i. H Di; lacking in Lb S

notes.de: habuero <hi rend="italic">statt</hi> h. u. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: habuero instead of h. u. Lb S

passages.en: And let all avoid mine, wherever I wish to have it.

passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Pręcipimus</hi> etiam, ut omnis homo<ptr n="8" target="IICn_82.lnote.oe.8"/> habeat pacem et securitatem <hi rend="spaced">eundo</hi> et redeundo ad placitum, nisi sit latro publicus<ptr n="9" target="IICn_82.lnote.oe.9"/> <hi rend="spaced">omnino</hi>.

notes.de: o. p. <hi rend="italic">H Di</hi>; publicatus <hi rend="italic">ohne</hi> om. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: o. p. H Di; publicatus without om. Lb S

passages.en: We <hi rend="spaced">command</hi> also that every man have peace and security <hi rend="spaced">going</hi> and returning to the court, unless he is <hi rend="spaced">altogether</hi> a public thief.

passages.text: Quisquis has leges, quas rex <hi rend="spaced">modo omnibus hominibus</hi> concessit <hi rend="spaced">et statuit</hi>, sit<ptr n="10" target="IICn_83.lnote.oe.10-2"/> Anglus sit Danus, uiolauerit, persoluat regi<ptr n="11" target="IICn_83.lnote.oe.11-2"/> pretium sui ipsius.

notes.de: si A. si D. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: si A. si D. Lb S

passages.en: Whoever, be he English or Dane, violates these laws which the king has <hi rend="spaced">now granted to all men</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and established</hi>, shall pay to the king his own price.

passages.text: Si secundo <hi rend="spaced">hoc idem fecerit</hi>, dupliciter<ptr n="12" target="IICn_83-1.lnote.oe.12"/> <hi rend="spaced">secundum superiorem rationem</hi> emendet.
passages.en: If a second time he <hi rend="spaced">does this same thing</hi>, he shall make amends doubly <hi rend="spaced">according to the above reckoning</hi>.

passages.text: Quod si <hi rend="spaced">audendo</hi> tertio<ptr n="13" target="IICn_83-2.lnote.oe.13"/> hoc presumpserit, perdat omnia sua. . . . . . .<ptr n="14" target="IICn_83-2.lnote.oe.14-2"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">II Cnut</hi> 84—84, 6 <hi rend="italic">fehlt; folgt Theil III; s. o. S.</hi> 93**.
notes.en: II Cnut 84—84, 6 lacking; Part III follows; see above p. 93**.

passages.en: But if <hi rend="spaced">daringly</hi> a third time he presumes this, he shall lose all his things. . . . . . .

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Si quis aliquid</hi><ptr n="1" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.1"/><hi rend="small">, <hi rend="spaced">pro aliqua forisfactura</hi>, accipiat</hi><ptr n="a" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.a"/><hi rend="small">, antequam iuste</hi><ptr n="2" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.2"/><hi rend="small"> rectitudinem petat, reddat quod accepit et</hi><ptr n="3" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.3"/><hi rend="small"> secundo persoluat; et</hi> <seg type="recension">(regi<ptr n="4" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.4"/>)</seg> <hi rend="small">quadraginta</hi><ptr n="b" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.b"/><hi rend="small"> solidos reddat</hi><ptr n="5" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.5"/> <seg type="recension">(aut<ptr n="6" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.6"/> illi<ptr n="c" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.c"/>)</seg> qui<ptr n="7" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.7"/> habet sacam et socnam suam; et insuper prętium suum<ptr n="5" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.5"/> domino<ptr n="9" target="InCn_III-1.lnote.oe.9"/> suo.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">Zwangspfand</hi> (nam <hi rend="italic">Cb u. S.</hi> 617) <hi rend="italic">wie</hi> II 19
notes.en: distraint (nam Cb below p. 617) as in II 19

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">aus Lb S Ct; fehlt H Di Rl T Cb</hi>
notes.en: from Lb S Ct; missing in H Di Rl T Cb

notes.de: XXX <hi rend="italic">Ine; Verf. rechnet spätere</hi> oferhyrnes <hi rend="italic">von</hi> 120 scil. <hi rend="italic">um, als meine</hi> scilling <hi rend="italic">Mercisch</hi> ⅓ solidus
notes.en: XXX Ine; the author converts the later oferhyrnes of 120 scil., as if scilling meant the Mercian ⅓ solidus

notes.de: a. i. <hi rend="italic">aus S; fehlt H Di Rl T Cb</hi>
notes.en: a. i. from S; missing in H Di Rl T Cb

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">auch</hi> II 15a. 28. 66. III 3 <hi rend="italic">berücksichtigt Verf. privaten Gerichtsertrag</hi>
notes.en: in II 15a. 28. 66. III 3 too the author takes account of private profits of jurisdiction

passages.en: <hi rend="small">If anyone takes something <hi rend="spaced">for some forfeiture</hi> before he justly seeks right, he shall give back what he took and pay a second time; and</hi> <seg type="recension">(to the king)</seg> <hi rend="small">shall pay forty shillings</hi> <seg type="recension">(or to him)</seg> who has his sake and soke; and in addition his price to his lord.

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Latrones appellamus usque VII homines, a septem usque XXXV</hi><ptr n="10" target="InCn_III-2.lnote.oe.10"/><hi rend="small"> <hi rend="spaced">uocant Angli</hi> hloth</hi><ptr n="11" target="InCn_III-2.lnote.oe.11"/><hi rend="small">, a</hi><ptr n="12" target="InCn_III-2.lnote.oe.12"/><hi rend="small"> XXXV dehinc</hi><ptr n="13" target="InCn_III-2.lnote.oe.13"/><hi rend="small"> erit</hi><ptr n="14" target="InCn_III-2.lnote.oe.14"/><hi rend="small"> exercitus.</hi>

notes.de: quod <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Lb S Ct</hi>
notes.en: quod added by Lb S Ct

notes.de: a XXXV <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S Ct</hi>
notes.en: a XXXV missing in Lb S Ct

passages.en: <hi rend="small">We call [them] thieves up to VII men; from seven to XXXV <hi rend="spaced">the English call [it]</hi> <hi rend="italic">hloth</hi> [band], from XXXV onward it will be an army.</hi>

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Qui calumniatur</hi><ptr n="15" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.15"/><hi rend="small"> de hloth</hi><ptr n="11" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.11"/><hi rend="small">, sí negauerit, ita sé purget:</hi> acceptis<ptr n="d" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.d"/> undecim hominibus, et ipse sit duodecimus; aut despectum<ptr n="e" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.e"/> calumniantis persoluat et duas libras pro<ptr n="16" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.16"/> forisfactura ei det qui habet consuetudines<ptr n="f" target="InCn_III-3.lnote.oe.f"/> suas.

notes.de: -umpn. <hi rend="italic">Cb und spätere Hss. stets;</hi> -tus est <hi rend="italic">S Ct</hi>
notes.en: -umpn. Cb and later M S S throughout; -tus est S Ct

notes.de: 120 Hiden <hi rend="italic">fordert Ine</hi> 14; <hi rend="italic">jeder Eideshelfer stellt also hier</hi> 10 <hi rend="italic">Hiden dar, wie auch im</hi> Quadr. Ine 19. 46
notes.en: Ine 14 requires 120 hides; each oath-helper here therefore represents 10 hides, as also in Quadr. Ine 19. 46

notes.de: mundbrece III 56; calumnians <hi rend="italic">ist hier und</hi> III 4 der Geschädigte
notes.en: mundbrece III 56; calumnians here and in III 4 is the injured party

notes.de: ei det p. f. <hi rend="italic">S;</hi> p. f. <hi rend="italic">fehlt Cb</hi>
notes.en: ei det p. f. S; p. f. missing in Cb

notes.de: = sacam et socnam III 1; <hi rend="italic">vgl.</hi> II 30, 3<hi rend="italic">b</hi>
notes.en: = sacam et socnam III 1; cf. II 30, 3b

passages.en: <hi rend="small">Whoever is accused of <hi rend="italic">hloth</hi> [band], if he denies it, shall clear himself thus:</hi> having taken eleven men, he himself being the twelfth; or he shall pay the accuser's contempt [fine] and give two pounds as forfeiture to him who has his customs.

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Et si quis calumniatur, quasi</hi><ptr n="17" target="InCn_III-4.lnote.oe.17"/><hi rend="small"> ducat exercitum</hi><ptr n="18" target="InCn_III-4.lnote.oe.18"/><hi rend="small"> super aliquem, et negauerit, purget se secundum prętium</hi> calumniantis<ptr n="e" target="InCn_III-4.lnote.oe.e"/> aut eum<ptr n="5" target="InCn_III-4.lnote.oe.5"/> persoluat.

notes.de: mundbrece III 56; calumnians <hi rend="italic">ist hier und</hi> III 4 der Geschädigte
notes.en: mundbrece III 56; calumnians here and in III 4 is the injured party

passages.en: <hi rend="small">And if anyone is accused as though he led an army against someone, and he denies it, he shall clear himself according to the price</hi> of the accuser, or pay it.

passages.text: Si quis<ptr n="1" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.1"/> per hloth<ptr n="2" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.2"/> occiderit hominem, <hi rend="bold">quem</hi><ptr n="3" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.3"/> <hi rend="bold">quidam</hi><ptr n="4" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.4"/> <hi rend="bold">Angli dicunt</hi><ptr n="5" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.5"/> tƿihende<ptr n="6" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.6"/> <hi rend="bold">et alii ceorlman,</hi> <hi rend="spaced">qui illum se occidisse</hi> cognouerit, persoluat<ptr n="7" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">secundum</hi><ptr n="8" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.8"/> were <hi rend="spaced">suum et etiam reddat forisfacturas</hi>, et<ptr n="9" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.9"/> quisque de<ptr n="10" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.10"/> <hi rend="spaced">sociis eius, qui tunc cum eo</hi> fuerunt<ptr n="11" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.11"/>, triginta sol. persoluat.<ptr n="12" target="Af_29.lnote.incn.12"/>

notes.de: A. q. <hi rend="italic">T; fehlt Cb Lb S Ct</hi>
notes.en: A. q. T; lacking in Cb Lb S Ct

notes.de: tƿiænde <hi rend="italic">Di H; geänd. in</hi> tƿihæ. <hi rend="italic">H T;</hi> twinde <hi rend="italic">S</hi>
notes.en: tƿiænde Di H; altered to tƿihæ. H T; twinde S

notes.de: eum <hi rend="italic">fügt zu H T Ct</hi>

passages.en: the fourth VI shillings,

passages.text: quintus V sol.
passages.en: the fifth V shillings.

passages.text: Si quis in uerendis ita<ptr n="3" target="Af_65.lnote.incn.3"/> uulneratur, ut non<ptr n="4" target="Af_65.lnote.incn.4"/> possit generare infantem<ptr n="5" target="Af_65.lnote.incn.5"/>, <hi rend="spaced">eius pretium</hi> octoginta sol. emend'.<ptr n="6" target="Af_65.lnote.incn.6"/>

notes.en: above the line H; tamen Cb

passages.en: If anyone is so wounded in the genitals that he cannot beget a child, he shall compensate <hi rend="spaced">his price</hi> with eighty shillings.

passages.text: Si<ptr n="7" target="Af_66.lnote.incn.7"/> cui <hi rend="spaced">abscidatur</hi> brachium cum manu ante cubitum, LXXX sol.<ptr n="8" target="Af_66.lnote.incn.8"/> emend'.

notes.de: IV libris <hi rend="italic">ohne</hi> em. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: IV libris without em. Lb S

passages.en: If someone's arm <hi rend="spaced">is cut off</hi> with the hand, before the elbow, he shall compensate LXXX shillings.

passages.text: Omne uulnus <hi rend="spaced">factum</hi> extra capillos et ante manicas <hi rend="bold">et ante cubitum</hi> et <hi rend="spaced">ante genu habebit duplex pretium</hi>.
passages.en: Every wound <hi rend="spaced">made</hi> outside the hair and before the sleeves <hi rend="bold">and before the elbow</hi> and <hi rend="spaced">before the knee shall have a double price</hi>.

passages.text: Si <hi rend="spaced">assatura renum, quam</hi><ptr n="9" target="Af_67.lnote.incn.9"/> <hi rend="spaced">Angli uocant</hi> lendebræde<ptr n="10" target="Af_67.lnote.incn.10"/>, omnino<ptr n="11" target="Af_67.lnote.incn.11"/> incisa fuerit, sexaginta<ptr n="12" target="Af_67.lnote.incn.12"/> sol. emend'.<ptr n="13" target="Af_67.lnote.incn.13"/>
passages.en: If the <hi rend="spaced">roast of the kidneys, which</hi> <hi rend="spaced">the English call</hi> <hi rend="italic">lendebræde</hi> [loin-roast], is entirely cut through, he shall compensate sixty shillings.

passages.text: Si autem infixa<ptr n="14" target="Af_67-1.lnote.incn.14"/> fuerit, quindecim sol. emend'.<ptr n="15" target="Af_67-1.lnote.incn.15"/>
passages.en: But if it is stabbed into, he shall compensate fifteen shillings.

passages.text: Si<ptr n="16" target="Af_67-2.lnote.incn.16"/> perforata fuerit, XXX sol. emend'.

notes.en: 67, 2 only H (in the lower margin) Di

passages.en: If it is pierced through, he shall compensate XXX shillings.

passages.text: Si quis uulneratur<ptr n="17" target="Af_68.lnote.incn.17"/> in humero, <hi rend="spaced">si uiuere potest, emendetur</hi><ptr n="18" target="Af_68.lnote.incn.18"/> ei<ptr n="19" target="Af_68.lnote.incn.19"/> octoginta sol.

notes.de: in h. v. <hi rend="italic">Lb T S</hi>
notes.en: in h. v. Lb T S

passages.en: If anyone is wounded in the shoulder, <hi rend="spaced">if he can live, let compensation be made</hi> to him with eighty shillings.

passages.text: Si quis percusserit manum <hi rend="spaced">alterius de foris, si potest mederi, dentur ei</hi> uiginti solidi.
passages.en: If anyone strikes the hand <hi rend="spaced">of another from outside, if it can be healed, let there be given to him</hi> twenty shillings.

passages.text: Si <hi rend="spaced">autem</hi> dimidia<ptr n="1" target="Af_69-1.lnote.incn.1"/> <hi rend="spaced">abscisa sit</hi><ptr n="2" target="Af_69-1.lnote.incn.2"/>, XL<ptr n="3" target="Af_69-1.lnote.incn.3"/> sol. <hi rend="spaced">emendentur</hi><ptr n="4" target="Af_69-1.lnote.incn.4"/> ei.

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">auf Rasur H;</hi> LX <hi rend="italic">Cb Di T S</hi>
notes.en: on an erasure H; LX Cb Di T S

passages.en: If <hi rend="spaced">however</hi> half <hi rend="spaced">is cut off</hi>, XL shillings <hi rend="spaced">shall be paid in compensation</hi> to him.

passages.text: Si quis costam <hi rend="spaced">hominis</hi> fregerit cute integra, emendet ei decem<ptr n="5" target="Af_70.lnote.incn.5"/> sol.
passages.en: If anyone breaks a rib <hi rend="spaced">of a man</hi> with the skin intact, he shall compensate him ten shillings.

passages.text: Quodsi cutis fracta fuerit<ptr n="6" target="Af_70-1.lnote.incn.6"/>, et os inde <hi rend="spaced">extrahatur</hi>, quindecim sol.<ptr n="7" target="Af_70-1.lnote.incn.7"/>
passages.en: But if the skin is broken, and bone <hi rend="spaced">is extracted</hi> from it, fifteen shillings.

passages.text: Si cui <hi rend="spaced">abscidatur</hi><ptr n="8" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.8"/> oculus, pes<ptr n="9" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.9"/> aut manus, <hi rend="spaced">ista tria</hi><ptr n="10" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.10"/> ęquale<ptr n="11" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.11"/> pretium <hi rend="spaced">habent, scilicet</hi><ptr n="12" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.12"/> sexaginta VI<ptr n="13" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.13"/> solid. et sex den. et tertiam<ptr n="14" target="Af_71.lnote.incn.14"/> partem denarii.

notes.de: in stateria [<hi rend="italic">frühere Verlesung von</hi> ista tria?] <hi rend="italic">fügt zu Di</hi>
notes.en: Di adds in stateria [an earlier misreading of ista tria?]

passages.en: If someone's eye, foot or hand <hi rend="spaced">is cut off</hi>, <hi rend="spaced">these three</hi> <hi rend="spaced">have</hi> an equal price, <hi rend="spaced">namely</hi> sixty-six shillings and six pence and a third part of a penny.

passages.text: Si alicui<ptr n="15" target="Af_72.lnote.incn.15"/> abscidatur crus <hi rend="spaced">usque ad</hi> genu, octoginta sol. ei<ptr n="16" target="Af_72.lnote.incn.16"/> <hi rend="spaced">emendentur</hi>.
passages.en: If someone's leg is cut off <hi rend="spaced">up to</hi> the knee, eighty shillings <hi rend="spaced">shall be paid in compensation</hi> to him.

passages.text: Si quis <hi rend="spaced">absciderit</hi><ptr n="17" target="Af_73.lnote.incn.17"/> scapulas <hi rend="spaced">alterius</hi>, uiginti sol. emendet.<ptr n="18" target="Af_73.lnote.incn.18"/>
passages.en: If anyone <hi rend="spaced">cuts off</hi> the shoulders <hi rend="spaced">of another</hi>, he shall compensate twenty shillings.

passages.text: Si <hi rend="spaced">autem ita percussus fuerit</hi><ptr n="19" target="Af_74.lnote.incn.19"/>, ut os inde abstrahatur<ptr n="20" target="Af_74.lnote.incn.20"/>, XV<ptr n="21" target="Af_74.lnote.incn.21"/> sol. ei<ptr n="22" target="Af_74.lnote.incn.22"/> emend'.

notes.en: emendentur ei Cb; lacking in T

passages.en: If <hi rend="spaced">however he has been so struck</hi> that bone is drawn out from it, he shall compensate him XV shillings.

passages.text: Si grossus neruus <hi rend="spaced">incisus</hi> fuerit <hi rend="spaced">et mederi</hi><ptr n="23" target="Af_75.lnote.incn.23"/> <hi rend="spaced">potest</hi><ptr n="24" target="Af_75.lnote.incn.24"/>, duodecim solidi <hi rend="spaced">emendentur</hi>.<ptr n="25" target="Af_75.lnote.incn.25"/>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">folgt Rasur H;</hi> non <hi rend="italic">fügen zu übrige</hi>
notes.en: an erasure follows H; the others add non

passages.en: If the great sinew <hi rend="spaced">is cut</hi> <hi rend="spaced">and it can</hi> <hi rend="spaced">be healed</hi>, twelve shillings <hi rend="spaced">shall be paid in compensation</hi>.

passages.text: Si autem claudus fuerit<ptr n="26" target="Af_75-1.lnote.incn.26"/> <hi rend="spaced">propter incisionem nerui</hi><ptr n="27" target="Af_75-1.lnote.incn.27"/>, ita ut sanari non possit, triginta sol. emend'.<ptr n="25" target="Af_75-1.lnote.incn.25"/>
passages.en: But if he is lame <hi rend="spaced">because of the cutting of the sinew</hi>, so that he cannot be cured, he shall compensate thirty shillings.

passages.text: Si delicatiores<ptr n="28" target="Af_76.lnote.incn.28"/> <seg type="recension">(id est minores)</seg> nerui <hi rend="spaced">incisi fuerint</hi>, VI sol. emend'.<ptr n="25" target="Af_76.lnote.incn.25"/>

notes.de: delicationes, <hi rend="italic">am Rande</hi> uel delicatiores <hi rend="italic">H;</hi> id e. mi. <hi rend="italic">übergeschr. H Di; nur</hi> del. <hi rend="italic">Cb T; nur</hi> min. <hi rend="italic">Lb S</hi>
notes.en: delicationes, with uel delicatiores in the margin H; id e. mi. above the line H Di; only del. Cb T; only min. Lb S

passages.en: If the more delicate <seg type="recension">(that is, smaller)</seg> sinews <hi rend="spaced">are cut</hi>, he shall compensate VI shillings.

passages.text: Si cui <hi rend="spaced">nerui et uenę</hi> super<ptr n="1" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.1"/> collum ita<ptr n="2" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.2"/> <hi rend="spaced">incidantur, ut non possit collum erigere, et tamen sic deformatus uiuat</hi>, centum solidi ei<ptr n="3" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.3"/> dentur<ptr n="4" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.4"/> pro emendatione, nisi sapientes maiorem illi<ptr n="5" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.5"/> <hi rend="spaced">rectitudinem iudicent</hi>.<ptr n="6" target="Af_77.lnote.incn.6"/> . . .
passages.en: If someone's <hi rend="spaced">sinews and veins</hi> on the neck are so <hi rend="spaced">cut that he cannot raise his neck, and yet he lives thus disfigured</hi>, a hundred shillings shall be given him as compensation, unless the wise <hi rend="spaced">adjudge</hi> him a greater <hi rend="spaced">right</hi>. . . .

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Si quis alii</hi><ptr n="22" target="InCn_III-40.lnote.oe.22"/><hi rend="small"> arma sua pręstiterit, et ille, <hi rend="spaced">cui pręstita sunt</hi>, inde hominem occiderit, ipse</hi><ptr n="g" target="InCn_III-40.lnote.oe.g"/><hi rend="small"> qui arma pręstitit</hi><ptr n="23" target="InCn_III-40.lnote.oe.23"/><hi rend="small"> tertiam partem pretii et forisfacturę persoluat; aut se</hi><ptr n="24" target="InCn_III-40.lnote.oe.24"/><hi rend="small"> purget, quod non fuit <hi rend="spaced">consilium nec uoluntas eius</hi>.</hi>

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">Verf. lässt die Vereinigung von Ver- und Entleiher zur Wergeldzahlung fort</hi>
notes.en: The author omits the joining of lender and borrower in the payment of the wergild

passages.en: <hi rend="small">If anyone has lent his weapons to another, and he <hi rend="spaced">to whom they were lent</hi> kills a man with them, he himself who lent the weapons shall pay a third part of the price and of the forfeiture; or he shall clear himself, that it was not <hi rend="spaced">his counsel nor his will</hi>.</hi>

passages.text: . . . Si canis hominem dilacerauerit<ptr n="1" target="Af_23.lnote.incn.1"/> aut occiderit, prima uice ille <hi rend="spaced">cuius canis est</hi> ei<ptr n="2" target="Af_23.lnote.incn.2"/> emendet sex sol.; et si <hi rend="spaced">post hoc</hi><ptr n="3" target="Af_23.lnote.incn.3"/> eundem canem pauerit, duodecim solidos persoluat; tertia <hi rend="spaced">uero uice, si idem</hi><ptr n="4" target="Af_23.lnote.incn.4"/> <hi rend="spaced">fecerit, dominus eius</hi> triginta sol. <hi rend="spaced">emendet</hi>.

notes.de: hoc <hi rend="italic">fügt zu S,</hi> hec <hi rend="italic">Lb</hi>

passages.en: . . . If a dog tears or kills a man, the first time he <hi rend="spaced">whose dog it is</hi> shall compensate him six shillings; and if <hi rend="spaced">after this</hi> he feeds the same dog, he shall pay twelve shillings; the third <hi rend="spaced">time, however, if it</hi> <hi rend="spaced">does the same, its master</hi> shall <hi rend="spaced">compensate</hi> thirty shillings.

passages.text: Et <hi rend="spaced">quamuis</hi> canis in tali facto perierit, tamen emendatio <hi rend="spaced">persoluatur</hi>.
passages.en: And <hi rend="spaced">although</hi> the dog perishes in such a deed, nevertheless the compensation <hi rend="spaced">shall be paid</hi>.

passages.text: <hi rend="spaced">Quodsi canis adhuc plura</hi><ptr n="5" target="Af_23-2.lnote.incn.5"/> <hi rend="spaced">his mala peregerit</hi>, et <hi rend="spaced">supradictus dominus</hi> <seg type="recension">(eius<ptr n="6" target="Af_23-2.lnote.incn.6"/>)</seg> illum adhuc retinuerit, emendet plenum<ptr n="7" target="Af_23-2.lnote.incn.7"/> <hi rend="spaced">pretium eius cui malum</hi> fecerit, <hi rend="spaced">siue sit uiolatio</hi> cicatricis <hi rend="spaced">siue sit</hi><ptr n="8" target="Af_23-2.lnote.incn.8"/> <hi rend="spaced">aliud</hi> . . . .

notes.en: only Cb; lacking in H Di Lb S

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">so H Di Pl; fehlt Cb</hi>
notes.en: so H Di Pl; lacking in Cb

passages.en: <hi rend="spaced">But if the dog has done still more</hi> <hi rend="spaced">harms than these</hi>, and <hi rend="spaced">the aforesaid master</hi> <seg type="recension">(its)</seg> still keeps it, he shall compensate the full <hi rend="spaced">price of the one to whom harm</hi> it has done, <hi rend="spaced">whether it be the violation of</hi> a scar <hi rend="spaced">or whether it be</hi> <hi rend="spaced">something else</hi> . . . .

passages.text: Prętium <hi rend="spaced">hominis</hi><ptr n="1" target="Mirce_1.lnote.oe.1-2"/>, <hi rend="bold">quem superius</hi><ptr n="a" target="Mirce_1.lnote.oe.a"/><ptr n="2" target="Mirce_1.lnote.oe.2-2"/><hi rend="bold"> nominauimus</hi> <hi rend="bold">ceorlman</hi><ptr n="3" target="Mirce_1.lnote.oe.3-2"/>, secundum legem Merciorum sunt CC solidi.

notes.de: eius <hi rend="italic">Lb S Pl Jo Ct</hi>
notes.en: eius Lb S Pl Jo Ct

passages.en: The price <hi rend="spaced">of a man</hi> <hi rend="bold">whom we have named above</hi> <hi rend="bold"><hi rend="italic">ceorlman</hi></hi>, according to the law of the Mercians, is CC shillings.

passages.text: [43] Liberalis hominis, <hi rend="spaced">id</hi><ptr n="4" target="Mirce_1-1.lnote.oe.4-2"/><hi rend="spaced"> est</hi> þegenes<ptr n="5" target="Mirce_1-1.lnote.oe.5-2"/>, pretium est<ptr n="6" target="Mirce_1-1.lnote.oe.6-2"/> <hi rend="spaced">sexies</hi><ptr n="7" target="Mirce_1-1.lnote.oe.7-2"/> tantum, id est duodecies C sol.

notes.en: eius Cb Lb S Pl Jo Ct

passages.en: [43] The price of a free man of rank (thegn), <hi rend="spaced">that is</hi> of a <hi rend="italic">þegenes</hi> [thegn's], is <hi rend="spaced">six times</hi> as much, that is twelve times C shillings.

passages.text: [43, 1] Sexies<ptr n="7" target="Mirce_2.lnote.oe.7"/> autem tantum<ptr n="8" target="Mirce_2.lnote.oe.8-2"/> erit simplum prętium regis, hoc<ptr n="9" target="Mirce_2.lnote.oe.9-2"/> est <hi rend="bold">ducente</hi><ptr n="10" target="Mirce_2.lnote.oe.10-2"/> XX<ptr n="11" target="Mirce_2.lnote.oe.11-2"/> librę.

notes.en: id S Jo Ct; hoc — librę in the margin Di

notes.en: -ti H; CC Cb; cf. above p. 461ᵇ

notes.de: <hi rend="italic">fehlt Lb S Pl Jo Ct</hi>
notes.en: missing in Lb S Pl Jo Ct

passages.en: [43, 1] But six times as much will be the single price of the king, that is <hi rend="bold">two hundred</hi> XX pounds.

passages.text: [43, 2] Tantum<ptr n="12" target="Mirce_3.lnote.oe.12"/> secundum<ptr n="13" target="Mirce_3.lnote.oe.13"/> iustitiam est<ptr n="14" target="Mirce_3.lnote.oe.14"/> prętium <hi rend="spaced">regis</hi>.

notes.en: 43, 2 skipped in Di; propter added by Jo

notes.de: r. est p. <hi rend="italic">Lb S Pl Jo Ct</hi>
notes.en: r. est p. Lb S Pl Jo Ct

passages.en: [43, 2] So much according to justice is the price <hi rend="spaced">of the king</hi>.

passages.text: [43, 3] Sed propter <hi rend="spaced">excellentiam</hi> regię dignitatis conuenit iterum tantundem<ptr n="15" target="Mirce_3-1.lnote.oe.15"/> <hi rend="spaced">dare</hi>.

notes.de: tantum <hi rend="italic">Lb S Pl Jo Ct</hi>
notes.en: tantum Lb S Pl Jo Ct

passages.en: [43, 3] But because of the <hi rend="spaced">excellence</hi> of the royal dignity it is fitting <hi rend="spaced">to give</hi> again just as much.

passages.text: [43, 4] Parentes <seg type="recension">(uero<ptr n="16" target="Mirce_4.lnote.oe.16-2"/>)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">regis</hi> iuste <hi rend="spaced">debent habere simplum</hi> prętium eius <seg type="recension">(regis<ptr n="17" target="Mirce_4.lnote.oe.17-2"/>)</seg> et populus <hi rend="spaced">aliud</hi><ptr n="18" target="Mirce_4.lnote.oe.18"/>.

notes.en: instead of eius only in Cb

passages.en: [43, 4] The kinsmen <seg type="recension">(however)</seg> <hi rend="spaced">of the king</hi> justly <hi rend="spaced">ought to have the single</hi> price of him <seg type="recension">(the king)</seg>, and the people the <hi rend="spaced">other</hi>.

passages.text: <hi rend="small">Sacramentum liberalis</hi><ptr n="i" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.i"/><hi rend="small"> hominis, <hi rend="spaced">quem</hi></hi><ptr n="25" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.25"/><hi rend="small"><hi rend="spaced"> quidem</hi></hi><ptr n="26" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.26"/><hi rend="small"><hi rend="spaced"> Angli</hi></hi><ptr n="27" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.27"/><hi rend="small"><hi rend="spaced"> uocant</hi></hi><ptr n="28" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.28"/><hi rend="small"> tƿelfhende</hi><ptr n="29" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.29"/> <seg type="recension"><hi rend="small">(man</hi><ptr n="30" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.30"/><hi rend="small">)</hi></seg><hi rend="small">, <hi rend="spaced">debet stare et</hi> ualere iuramentum sex</hi><ptr n="31" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.31"/><hi rend="small"> uillanorum, quia</hi><ptr n="32" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.32"/><hi rend="small"> prętium eius est</hi><ptr n="33" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.33"/><hi rend="small">, id est ƿeregeld</hi><ptr n="k" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.k"/><ptr n="34" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.34"/><hi rend="small">, sex</hi><ptr n="35" target="InCn_III-44.lnote.oe.35"/><hi rend="small"> uillanorum.</hi>

notes.de: überfrei, adlig <hi rend="italic">auch S.</hi> 621<sup>a</sup>. 624<sup>m</sup>; <hi rend="italic">schon Cnuts Urkunden setzen</hi> þegn <hi rend="italic">und</hi> twelfhynde <hi rend="italic">synonym</hi>
notes.en: more than free, noble, also p. 621<sup>a</sup>. 624<sup>m</sup>; Cnut’s charters already use þegn and twelfhynde as synonyms

notes.en: dicunt Lb Pl S Jo Va

notes.en: -hænde H Di Rl; thel. Va; chel. Pl
